facts.interpretation.statement: The dev-only last-trigger/0.75 combination is an after-the-fact schedule audit. It cannot be used as an online causal method because selecting the last trigger requires knowing later trajectory events. The sealed-test figures are a diagnostic generalization check only.
data_contract_review.findings: SFT success and Verifier unresolved are heterogeneous source/outcome proxies, not a single process-fault label contract.
Terminal resolved status does not identify a process fault or its first-fault interval.
The view/edit matching in the M1 visible-evidence layer can misclassify view-like actions as edit evidence.
Source and log keywords can contaminate visible_evidence because the marker rules scan action text and observations.
The existing 480 responses are negative evidence for this frozen pipeline only; they do not constitute a research Go result.

dev_pair_protocol.healthy_edit: append one inert comment to the target file before p00
dev_pair_protocol.post_change_edits: append the first two frozen inert comments to the two frozen distractor files
dev_pair_protocol.clean_main_change: apply clean_old -> clean_new in the target file exactly once

fault_main_change.A: apply fault_a_old -> fault_a_new in the target file exactly once
fault_main_change.B: write the clean-refactored full target content to <target_file>.agent_wrong while leaving the target without that refactor
fault_main_change.C: apply fault_c_old -> fault_c_new in the target file exactly once

probe_outcome_policy.py_compile: return code 0=healthy, 1=fault, timeout or any other return code=unknown
probe_outcome_policy.file_invariant: exact allowed changed-path set=healthy, any extra/missing path=fault, execution error=unknown
probe_outcome_policy.affected_test: pytest return code 0=healthy, 1=fault, timeout or return code 2/3/4/5/other=unknown

dev_pair_protocol.pair_validity_policy: p00 must be healthy in both conditions; p01 must be healthy for clean and fault for fault; otherwise invalidate the whole clean/fault pair
dev_pair_protocol.dev_claim_boundary: mechanism and data-plumbing check only; fixed s04 transition and fixed p01 evidence cannot support timely-detection or generalization claims
dev_pair_protocol.online_visibility: only task contract, current/past public events, current file state and current/past structured probe evidence
dev_pair_protocol.private_evaluator_only: condition, mode, constructed transition ordinal and expected clean/fault probe status

complete_config.purpose: 在无目标泄漏的任务级折外预测条件下，检验可观察传播证据相对于仅责任 Agent 先验是否增加动作定位价值。此 Pilot 的主要结论是 GO 或 NO-GO，不以追求漂亮数字为目的。

data.selection_rule: 保留六种具有多个可识别 Agent 输出的框架；展开 round.turns；每条记录必须有至少一个可由现有 ground_truth 映射的候选事件。单 Agent alfagent/smolagents 记录只用于 schema 审计，不进入本 Pilot 主 Gate。

mapping_rule.macnet: 优先使用 accepted_predictions 中 agent_name 与 step_coord；step_coord 的 position 对应当前事件顺序。没有 accepted_predictions 时使用 canonical round.position，并只接受 agent 一致的唯一事件。
mapping_rule.metagpt: 匹配 agent_id 与 stage；唯一匹配事件为金标集合。
mapping_rule.magentic-one: 解析 ground_truth.step 的 round.position，匹配 agent 与 round、position。
mapping_rule.debate_dylan: 展开 round.turns；匹配 ground_truth.agents 与 round。由于缺少唯一 position，保留该 round 中所有匹配 Agent 事件作为多金标集合。
mapping_rule.not_a_causal_claim: ground_truth 是责任步骤/模式标注，用于训练标签和评价；它不是动作干预得到的因果金标。

split.strict_grouping: 同一原始任务的所有 rollout、框架重复和成败变体不得跨折；所有第一章派生分数在测试任务上都必须由未见任务训练得到。
split.oof_definition: 每个测试任务的预测来自没有使用该任务 ground_truth 训练过的模型；桥接排序器只在外层训练任务的折外预测上拟合。

allowed_observable_fields: local token overlap and state-transition proxies
observability_and_leakage_controls.role_anonymization: 每条任务按可观察的首次出现顺序把原始 Agent/role/agent_id 替换为 Agent-A、Agent-B……；模型特征不包含原始角色名。

explicit_error_word_masking.audit: 脚本分别输出清洗前后命中数、被丢弃的注入事件数和含模板标记的任务数；屏蔽只用于特征，不改变候选或金标。

observability_and_leakage_controls.injection_template_screening: 任何 is_injected=true 或 is_replayed=true 事件的输出不进入文本特征；字段 injection_via、ledger、accepted_predictions 及注释被丢弃。事件仍可作为候选，避免通过删样本改变评价集合。

candidate_and_target.candidate_unit: 一个带可识别 Agent 的输出/动作事件；round.turns 被展开为事件，user/final_answer/无 Agent 的容器不作为候选。
candidate_and_target.target: 每条任务的 gold event set；多金标任务只要任一金标排入 Top-K 即命中，MRR 取排名最前金标的倒数。

methods.common_budget: 六种条件使用同一个候选池、同一清洗文本、同一轻量排序器、同一折划分和同一特征计算；只替换责任先验来源。
modules: 全过程可观察证据：输出/动作/观察、工具类型和顺序特征。
时序与状态转移代理：相邻事件状态变化、重复/验证/修正和时间位置特征。
依赖聚合与症状抑制：仅由可观察文本 token overlap、读写/工具线索和后续验证线索构造传播依赖；对末步/验证症状做软抑制。

conditions.No Prior: OOF 局部可观察证据排序，不使用 Agent 责任先验或传播先验。
conditions.Predicted Agent-only: No Prior 加任务级 OOF 的责任 Agent 概率；Agent 概率来自训练任务的局部证据模型聚合，未使用测试任务 gold。
conditions.Predicted Propagation: Predicted Agent-only 加任务级 OOF 的事件传播/依赖分数和症状软抑制；传播分数由训练任务标签拟合，测试时只看可观察字段。
conditions.Shuffled Propagation: 保持 Predicted Agent-only 不变，把传播组件在同一外层折的任务之间随机置换；不重算金标或候选。
conditions.Oracle Agent: 只提供 gold Agent/Agent 集合以限制软先验；不提供 gold step。
conditions.Oracle Propagation: 允许用 gold source event 确定其后续可观察依赖链的上界；动作排序分数只能来自该链上的可观察入/出依赖强度，禁止给 source event 一个固定常量高分，也禁止使用距 gold step 的位置、ground_truth mode 或注入模板。该条件测试的是“下游依赖反推源动作”的信息上界。

metrics.symptom_definition: 不使用 gold 的可观察代理：最后一个候选事件，以及含 verify/check/test/review/final/answer/report/summary 的末端验证/汇报事件；若 Top-1 为这些事件且不在 gold set，记为症状/末步误判。
metrics.reporting: 每个条件报告原始分数、相对于 Predicted Agent-only 的绝对差和相对差；同时按 framework、候选数和多金标状态分层。
metrics.uncertainty: 以 task-cluster 为重采样单位，seed=20260818，2000 次 paired bootstrap，报告 2.5% 和 97.5% 百分位 CI。

go_gate.main_fair_gate: Predicted Propagation 相对 Predicted Agent-only 在预先指定主要指标至少一个达到相对提升 >= 0.10，且 task-cluster paired bootstrap CI 下界 > 0；同时不允许 Recall@1、Recall@3、MRR 全部下降。
go_gate.oracle_gate: Oracle Propagation 必须优于 Oracle Agent-only，至少一个主要指标 paired bootstrap CI 下界 > 0；否则传播增量主线 NO-GO。
go_gate.shuffled_negative_control: Shuffled Propagation 不得复现 Predicted Propagation 的增益；其与 Agent-only 的主要指标差异须小于 Predicted Propagation 的差异，且不能形成独立的 CI 下界 > 0。
go_gate.coverage_gate: 传播先验不得让 gold candidate 从候选池中被硬删除；所有条件 gold coverage 必须为 1.0。
go_gate.decision: 所有 gate 通过为 GO；任一主 Gate 失败为 NO-GO，不得通过改变阈值或偷偷更换主指标修复。诊断分析必须单独标记。

required_commands: python3 run_pilot.py --data <absolute path to text.jsonl> --out results --seed 20260818
reproducibility.preregistration_boundary: 本 protocol.json 必须在任何 results.json、predictions.jsonl 或主结果报告提交前单独提交；首次主结果不得修改冻结的 go_gate。

known_limits: WhoWhenPro 文本轨迹的 propagation chain 不是人工因果图；Oracle Propagation 是依赖证据上界，不是因果证明。
Debate/Dylan 的 round-agent 金标是集合，不能与唯一 action step 等价。
该 Pilot 只验证离线动作排序增量，不替代后续可执行动作替换/重放。
核心 Agent 论文身份、CCF 和许可证在最终报告中单独引用，不把本数据预印本标签当作因果证据。

preprocessing_change.universal_cleaning: 所有事件统一提取 output/action/observation/tool type/name，并对同一正则词表做显式错误词屏蔽；不因事件旗标删文本、不删候选、不改变事件顺序。

bridge_change.motivation: Agent-only 先验已经跨 Agent 聚合；传播证据更合理的作用是同一匿名 Agent 内的动作细化，而不是再次改变 Agent 间责任竞争。
bridge_change.predicted_propagation: 先由训练任务 OOF 模型得到事件传播概率，再对每个任务内同一 Agent 的传播概率减去该 Agent 的均值，作为动作级 residual；固定分数为 base + 0.35*PredictedAgent + 3.0*within_agent_propagation_residual。
bridge_change.shuffled: 同一外层折和同一 framework 内汇集事件级传播分数后随机置换，再按当前任务候选数分配并做 Agent 内中心化；这样打断任务/位置对应关系而保留同框架分布。
bridge_change.oracle_propagation: gold source 只选后续可观察依赖链；使用未中心化的链上 incoming/outgoing strength，固定分数为 base + 0.35*OracleAgent + 0.35*oracle_chain_strength。该 source 仍无常量加分或 gold distance。

interpretation.not_a_new_theory: Agent 内 residual 是成熟学习排序中的条件化特征组合；不声称首次提出传播、症状或依赖图。
interpretation.confirmation_claim: 若全数据 v2 通过，结论只能写为在无构造标记依赖且严格 OOF 的修正协议上技术可行；v1 预注册主结果仍永久保留为 NO-GO/被混淆。
interpretation.causal_boundary: 离线金标排序仍不是动作因果根因；需要后续 replay/do-intervention 复核。

references_and_overlap: FALAT https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00765 已覆盖 typed dependency、source/propagation/symptom/contributing 与 dependency-guided ranking；v2 只检验严格 OOF 与 matched-budget 的增量。

TrajDebug https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06346 已覆盖错误生命周期和终局影响；Causal Agent Replay https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08275 已覆盖 do-intervention/replay/CI；ErrorProbe https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17658 已覆盖症状驱动反向追踪。它们是邻近基线，不是被忽略的空白。

operator_rules.EnvelopeCanonicalize: Strip a JSON code fence or one unambiguous outer wrapper only when the extracted payload parses; preserve the payload semantics.
operator_rules.NameCanonicalize: Map function name and parameter keys only when normalized case/punctuation/underscore matching yields exactly one public-schema target; otherwise leave unchanged.
operator_rules.SafeTypeCoerce: Apply only unambiguous scalar conversions against the public schema: true/false, integer, finite number, and no other semantic inference.
operator_rules.DropInvalid: Remove calls that are not JSON objects, have no public-schema function name, have non-object arguments, unknown parameter keys, or missing required keys; unparseable response becomes an explicit empty call list.
operator_rules.FillFromCurrentLiteral: Fill exactly one missing required scalar parameter only when the current visible user text contains exactly one literal whose type matches that parameter; never read hidden state or future text.
operator_rules.Abstain: Replace the selected existing response item with an empty JSON call list; no new response or turn is created.
operator_rules.MinimalCombined: Apply EnvelopeCanonicalize, then NameCanonicalize, then SafeTypeCoerce, then DropInvalid in this fixed order, at most once per response item.
operator_rules.SchemaRuleRepair: Apply MinimalCombined once to the first changed response item in turn-major/response-major order; otherwise preserve No.

facts.papers[1].ccf_status: not independently asserted in this audit; not needed for the ACL Long count

MEM1 assumes well-defined verifiable rewards; open-ended tasks with sparse, delayed or implicit rewards remain future work.

grouping.test_group_exclusion: drop every non-test row whose bookkeeping task_group is in the sealed official-test group list

allowed: turns[0:k] only, including role/action/content/thought for observed turns

complete_config.base_selection: Within each training fold only, choose candidate and threshold by Exact-F1; ties choose lower FAR, lower ASS, then lexicographically smaller candidate and lower threshold.

mechanism_a.name: anonymous_causal_state_transition_recovery_memory
mechanism_a.state: A finite scalar transition/recovery state updated online from prior/current structural deltas, anonymous speaker switch, structural repetition, action/tool evidence, and recovery after tool/action transitions.
mechanism_a.same_budget: One fixed feature pass and one fixed scalar update per visible turn; no extra candidate, module, model, call, token, or latency budget.
mechanism_a.threshold: Chosen independently within each training fold from the frozen grid; never tuned on OOF rows.

ablations.state_deletion: Delete the transition/recovery state; Base+A must exactly equal the selected Base prediction per prefix.
ablations.masked_error: Diagnostic only: mask matched error-word characters with same-length x characters after the frozen fit. Error words are never a feature or tuning input; the A-vs-Base direction must not immediately disappear.

metrics.definitions: Locked AgentForesight inference/metrics.py convention: pred_step is an integer or -1; exact TP is unsafe and pred==gold; FP is pred!=-1 and pred!=gold; FN is unsafe and pred!=gold; ASS is mean absolute shift among unsafe predictions; FAR is safe alarms / safe; StepAcc is exact unsafe / unsafe.
metrics.uncertainty: Per-seed paired task-group bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20260822, percentile 95% CI on Base+A minus Base; each seed has 1,164 independent groups.
metrics.per_seed: Report paired Exact-F1 difference and task-group better/worse/tie counts.
metrics.pooled: Three seed OOF tables may be concatenated descriptively only; they are repeated predictions, not independent rows, and pooled rows do not receive an inferential CI.
metrics.cost_values: All zero for the offline deterministic runner.

continue_if: Base+A is genuinely positive versus frozen Base
direction is consistent across all three seeds or most independent task groups are positive
no implementation error, leakage, or extra budget
the masked-error diagnostic does not immediately remove the direction
stop_if: only injected subgroup improves while natural/diagnosed has no direction
any forbidden field, future dependence, test/group overlap, or fold-local tuning violation

mechanism_b.unresolved_hazard: Only PENDING without recovery can emit hazard: recent repeated structure, a consecutive new action/tool transition, or an explicit structural break.

mechanism_b.score: Base current-turn structural score plus the current bounded hazard; no cumulative score, position, length, metadata, classifier, model, or extra API/token budget.
mechanism_b.state_deletion: Deleting B returns every per-prefix score and prediction exactly to the selected Base.

trajectory_hashes.normalized_visible_turns: Recursively normalize visible turn strings by Unicode NFKC, strip, collapse whitespace, lowercase; hash canonical normalized turns JSON with sha256
trajectory_hashes.near_duplicate_definition: Rows sharing normalized_visible_turns_hash are exact normalized-visible-turn duplicates/near-duplicates; raw complete-trace hash differences are retained as a separate collision count
trajectory_hashes.safe_reference_rule: A reference and every query must have different complete_trace_hash values and different conv_id values
trajectory_hashes.manifest_hashing: Persisted group/trajectory/domain/source identifiers are sha256(MANIFEST_SALT + ':' + kind + ':' + internal_value); raw task, conv_id, and trace text are never persisted

qualification.safe_reference_query_pairs: Ordered pairs (safe reference, safe query) with different conv_id and complete_trace_hash; a qualifying reference must also pair with at least one unsafe query under the same non-self rule
qualification.unsafe_queries: Every independent clean unsafe trajectory is a failure query candidate; source is used only for qualification/stratification
qualification.qualified_group: At least two safe rows with two distinct conv_id and complete trace hashes, at least one unsafe row with a distinct conv_id, and at least one safe reference that has a valid safe query pair and a valid unsafe query pair
qualification.self_reference: Reference/query conv_id equality or complete_trace_hash equality invalidates that pair; no row is paired with itself

gates.failure_action: Do not run Base/A, lower thresholds, alter pairing, or claim method failure.

outputs.output_policy: group_manifest contains only salted/one-way hashes, counts, booleans, and distribution summaries; no task text, conv_id, turns, labels, or answer text

stage0_oracle.name: gold_evaluation_side_conservative_first_divergence_selector
stage0_oracle.scope: For each row, find the first currently visible prefix where Base and A alarm decisions differ under the fold-local Exp75 thresholds. Gold is used only after predictions are produced to choose one complete frozen route.
stage0_oracle.conservative_choice: If exactly one route is exact, choose it. If both are exact choose Base. If both are wrong, choose the route with fewer false-alarm consequences (prefer no alarm, then lower absolute step error, then Base). No candidate, threshold, prefix, or future prediction is changed.
stage0_oracle.ceiling: The resulting per-row choice is the maximum exact-F1 attainable by selecting only between the two already frozen Base/A route predictions; it is not a learned-method result.
stage0_oracle.stratification: source/domain are evaluator-side post-hoc strata only.
stage0_oracle.stop_if: STOP_ABSOLUTE_NO_SELECTION_SPACE only when conservative oracle Exact-F1 is not greater than Base Exact-F1.

stage1_gate.name: C_observable_utility_gate
stage1_gate.scope: At the first Base/A decision divergence only, choose accept-A or fallback-Base. Rows without a divergence use Base.

models.name: linear_ridge
models.description: Intercept plus standardized numeric features; closed-form ridge fit with deterministic Gaussian elimination; no semantic model or external dependency.

stage1_gate.fit_selection: For every frozen regularization/threshold pair, fit on the training fold only and select by training Exact-F1, then lower FAR, lower ASS, then lower regularization and lower threshold. A no-example/one-class fit is a deterministic constant fallback.

controls.random_gate: Deterministic 50/50 route choice at each first divergence using a SHA-256 control key; no Gold or feature input.
controls.shuffled_gate: Same frozen linear-ridge gate with training utility labels deterministically shuffled within each fold; OOF inference remains prefix-observable.

stage1_gate.deletion: Disabling C must return the exact Base prediction for every row.

metrics.uncertainty: Task-group paired bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20260822; CI is for each OOF seed's Base-vs-method Exact-F1 delta.
report: rescuable hit rate and harmful acceptance rate

decision.continue: Oracle ceiling > Base; C has any genuine positive seed delta, at least two positive seeds or majority independent groups positive, no leakage/extra budget, and C beats both negative controls; otherwise stop only this observable-gate implementation.
decision.absolute_stop: Only oracle ceiling <= Base permits STOP_ABSOLUTE_NO_SELECTION_SPACE.
decision.gate_stop: C <= Base is STOP_C_NOT_POSITIVE and does not turn a positive oracle ceiling into a NO-GO for selective direction.

facts.bootstrap_negative_tail.mechanism: A harmful group can add FP while leaving TP/FN unchanged. A bootstrap draw that over-samples such groups has the same TP but a larger TP+FP+FN denominator, so C Exact-F1 becomes lower even when exact-correct group counts call the group a tie.
facts.component_totals.interpretation: strict aggregate is +3 TP, +0 net FP, -3 FN; gross FP movement is +2 in harmful groups and -2 in beneficial groups, so net FP hides the component risk.
facts.exact_correct_group_counts_only.meaning: 3/0/202 compares only the number of rows exactly correct in each group; tie does not mean no FP/FN harm.
facts.scope.category_definitions.beneficial: delta TP > 0, delta FP <= 0, delta FN <= 0
facts.scope.category_definitions.harmful: delta TP <= 0, delta FP >= 0, delta FN >= 0, with at least one nonzero delta
facts.scope.category_definitions.mixed: none of the above Pareto cases
facts.scope.component_orientation: TP higher is beneficial; FP and FN lower are beneficial

execution_boundary.raw_download_policy: Every response is range-limited or a small metadata/API response. A range request must return HTTP 206 and must not exceed its declared range. Raw samples are written only below runtime/, which is ignored and never committed.
execution_boundary.media_policy: Do not download image/video assets. Their split row counts and schema are read from datasets-server metadata; only text/video metadata samples are queried, and no media bytes are retained.

qualification_rules.unit: strict confirmation group = same-task/group safe reference/query plus an independent decisive-step unsafe query, all with auditable ordered prefixes
qualification_rules.safe_execution: A complete execution whose released row/outcome is successful or safe; a successful prefix inside an injected failure is not a safe execution.
qualification_rules.unsafe_execution: A complete released failure trajectory with an explicit decisive-step/when label, not merely a paper-level total.
qualification_rules.strict_group_requirement: At least one safe execution and one decisive-step unsafe execution must be present in the same task group. No safe row means zero qualifying groups, regardless of the number of failure rows.

asset_grouping.traceelephant: Use metadata.task_id as the frozen task-group key. The archive has 220 failure trace units and 174 unique task_id groups; each group is decisive-step unsafe when its trace metadata contains mistake_step.
asset_grouping.whowhen_pro: Use the normalized task value hash only for the bounded observed sample. The full 10,784-row task-group enumeration is intentionally not performed at the asset gate, so the full decisive-step unsafe-group count is unknown; report sampled rows and sampled groups separately.
asset_grouping.counting_boundary: Failure-only decisive-step groups are not strict confirmation groups. A nonzero failure-only count supports localization/attribution evidence, but cannot satisfy the safe-versus-unsafe paired Exact-F1 gate.

qualification_rules.gold_boundary: Gold is used only as an evaluation target in a future confirmation. It must not be an input feature. A source lacking a complete safe outcome cannot be repaired by treating its successful prefix as Gold safe.
qualification_rules.absolute_stop_reason: The released records contain injected failure trajectories but no complete safe counterpart with the same task/group; therefore Exp80's paired safe-versus-unsafe metric is undefined, and opening a confirmation would require inventing a safe label or using a successful prefix as a complete execution. This stops only the current paired confirmation asset gate, not failure-only decisive-step localization.

adapter.sort: source step_number ascending; duplicate source steps are excluded
adapter.role: anonymous generic tokens; only equality/change is retained for role_switch, identity values never enter PrefixObservation
adapter.thought: reasoning or thought nonempty structural state only

adapter.tools: only explicit public row/event tools/tool_name/tool_calls fields; no Gold, injected, mode, task, framework, benchmark, or id

metrics.primary: exact StepAcc on eligible failure-only rows

metrics.fair_baseline: max(Base,A,fixed_step1,fixed_midpoint) by observed StepAcc; tie priority Base then A then fixed_step1 then fixed_midpoint

decision.EXTERNAL_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION_GO: eligible rows >=100 and task groups >=100, C improves strongest fair baseline by >0 absolute and >=10% relative, paired CI lower >0, better>worse, Gold>1 C-vs-Base positive, seals/deletion/leakage/cost all pass
decision.POSITIVE_VS_BASE_NOT_GO: C improves Base but does not clear strongest-baseline/10%/CI gate; preserve the real improvement and do not STOP
decision.ZERO_SHOT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: C <= Base; rejects only this frozen adapter+model transfer, not the direction
decision.ASSET_ADAPTER_STOP: eligible rows or groups below 100 because the released flat decisive-step object is insufficient; absolute reason must be reported and does not count as method failure
decision.HARNESS_INVALID: any revision/seal/Gold leakage/adapter/evaluator/cost violation; no scientific interpretation

eligibility.required_step_records: ordered list; every event has a unique strictly increasing integer step_id
eligibility.gold_match: metadata.mistake_step must parse to exactly one observed step_id; ambiguous, empty, duplicate, or out-of-range values are excluded
eligibility.group: sha1(normalized metadata.task_id)[:16]; multiple runs with the same task_id share a task group
eligibility.sample_exclusion: the one adapter-development run is excluded before method eligibility and all of its rows are absent from denominators

adapter.causal_input_boundary: current event and all prior events only; no task_instruction, ground_truth, mistake_reason, mistake_agent, task_id, run_id, system_name, or metadata enters the method
adapter.role: use agent_name if present, otherwise agent_id, only for equality; replace identities with anonymous role tokens before PrefixObservation
adapter.action: canonical JSON structure of current tool_logs calls only; retain public function name/type and argument type/length shape, never argument keys or values
adapter.content: constant structural marker for nonempty current output; no output text or semantic values
adapter.tools: cumulative public tool names observed through the current prefix; names are used only by action-tool structural matching
adapter.input_field_use: only current/past input existence structure may contribute; no future event is visible
adapter.input_projection: input is represented only by nonempty/existence structure; input text is never read
adapter.structure_repeat: normalized action/tool-call structure only; no text
adapter.recovery_evidence: fixed zero because TraceElephant source schema has no explicit recovery/status field

frozen_method.gate: Exp80 pre_unseal.json final_gate_fit.fitted_parameters, no_length_C, exact model_sha256; no TraceElephant tuning
frozen_method.prediction_space: method predictions are internal indices during scoring and must be mapped to original step_id before evaluation
frozen_method.random_route: stable sha256 of the projected current-prefix turns/tools low bit selects A or Base at the first divergence; no metadata, future event, or random seed tuning
frozen_method.strongest_fair_baseline: maximum aggregate exact StepAcc among Base, A, always_step1, midpoint; ties resolved in that listed order

metrics.primary: exact StepAcc = percentage of eligible failure traces whose predicted original step_id equals metadata.mistake_step
secondary: ASS = mean absolute internal-index distance on non-abstained predictions
metrics.nonfirst_stratum: Gold internal index > 0; report C versus Base and C versus always_step1

download.range_policy: every new member header and compressed-body request must return HTTP 206 with an exact Content-Range; requested range and response hash/bytes are recorded

decision.EXTERNAL_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION_GO: eligible >= 100 rows and >= 100 task groups; C beats strongest fair baseline; relative gain >= 10%; paired CI lower > 0; better > worse; non-first Gold layer C is positive versus Base; all sealing/leakage/cost audits pass
decision.POSITIVE_VS_BASE_NOT_GO: C is positive versus Base but strongest-baseline or confirmation gates are not met; retain the conditional external signal
decision.ZERO_SHOT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: C <= Base; this rejects only this frozen zero-shot adapter transfer, not Exp80 direction
decision.ASSET_ADAPTER_STOP: fewer than 100 eligible rows or groups, or byte/range/JSON eligibility cannot be established within cap

original_reproduction.reproduction_rule: The generated confirmation_results.json must be byte-identical to the historical result hash; otherwise E85 is invalid and no robust verdict is issued.

single_diagnostic.name: joint_observable_de_shortcut
single_diagnostic.hypothesis: 若 E2 bridge 的提升不是由位置、任务文本/ID、域名或原始角色名/角色身份捷径造成，则在角色按每条轨迹首次出现顺序匿名、清空任务文本/ID/域名、删除 E1 位置/角色身份/域名/任务重叠特征，并令 E2 w_pos=0 后，full 相对最强公平 baseline 仍应保持正向提升。

observable_transform.role_anonymization: 每条轨迹独立扫描 turns，首次出现的真实 role 依次替换为 role_0、role_1、...；原始 role string 不进入模型。
observable_transform.task_and_id: model-visible task='', conv_id='opaque_conv_<row>'; task_group 只用于冻结 split 和审计，不进入特征。
observable_transform.domain: model-visible domain=''；domain one-hot 和 role identity features 全部删除。
observable_transform.e2_removed_position: 固定 w_pos=0，且 full/local/no_bridge 的同分 tie-break 只使用匿名 role+当前内容的稳定哈希，不使用步骤 index；recency 仅作预注册简单基线。

single_diagnostic.gold_usage: mistake_agent 作为 train task_group 的 E1 监督标签使用，但绝不作为任何样本的输入特征；confirm task_group 的 mistake_agent 只用于最终评分。mistake_step 对 train/confirm 都不进入任何输入，只用于最终步骤评分；reason/gold/task/id/domain 不进入模型输入。
single_diagnostic.budget: 所有条件同一数据、同一 9 维 E1 输入、同一 LR 超参数、同一 E2 权重、同一评估调用数；无调参。

split_and_oos.official_test_exclusion: 排除官方 test_unsafe/test_safe conv_id 及其 task_group；其余按 sha1(task_group + '|group6-confirm-v1') % 5 == 0 进入 confirm，其余 train。
split_and_oos.bridge: full 只使用 train task_group 训练后对 confirm task_group 的 OOS 概率；另记录 train 内 5-fold task_group OOF 审计。
leakage_assertions: train task_group 与 confirm task_group 交集为 0
full bridge 预测 rec 集合等于 confirm 评价 rec 集合
fit task_group 与预测 task_group 不相交

conditions.deletion: no_bridge 删除 OOS bridge；shuffle_bridge 在每条 confirm 轨迹内固定随机置换 OOS role probabilities，作为同预算破坏性负对照。

statistics.ci: task_group paired bootstrap 95% percentile CI of per-group delta

decision.robust_go: REPRODUCED_ROBUST_GO iff original replay hash matches; full_de_shortcut beats strongest fair local/no_bridge/recency baseline by >=10% relative; paired task_group CI lower >0; deletion and shuffle remove or materially reduce bridge gain; all leakage assertions pass.
decision.positive_not_go: 任何真实正增益但未同时满足上述门槛，记 POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO，不停止方向，不改称 NO-GO。
decision.exact_stop_scope: 若去捷径实现相对最强公平 baseline 无真实正增益，只停止本次 joint_observable_de_shortcut 实现；绝对原因是本冻结输入下未观察到提升，排除的是该联合输入/固定权重机制，不排除历史 E33 原始 positive 或其他机制。
decision.no_direction_no_go: 本实验单独不能触发方向 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO；方向停止需要三种实质不同机制失败并独立复审。

pre_run_protocol_correction.correction: The clean representation is now explicitly a normalized action-class histogram. The negative control is a deterministic cross-task-group reference assignment computed separately inside each outer train/test partition; donor and target task groups are never equal, donor groups never cross the target partition, and the donor reference list is cyclically matched to the target candidate count. historical_replay.purpose: independent reproducibility anchor using the frozen E29 implementation and original feature protocol

clean_paired_reference.purpose: same-task success reference with banned shortcut features removed
clean_paired_reference.features: normalized histogram similarities between current prefix action signatures and same-task successful reference signatures; no observation text, task text, task ID, outcome, role name, raw length, length difference, explicit prefix fraction, or explicit position match
clean_paired_reference.reference_information: same normalized task group only; references are success-side trajectories and are never used as labels

clean_no_reference.purpose: strongest fair no-reference comparator under exactly the same clean feature contract
clean_no_reference.features: current-prefix normalized action-signature histogram only; no reference and no banned shortcut

clean_cross_group_reference.purpose: negative control preserving the reference candidate budget while replacing each target's references with references from a different task group inside the same outer partition
clean_cross_group_reference.features: same clean_paired_reference features, with deterministic donor task-group assignment; donor != target and donor partition == target partition

reference_deletion.purpose: explicit deletion ablation; identical to clean_no_reference but named for the reference deletion audit

historical_fail_fast.purpose: reported legacy no-reference baseline from the exact historical runner; not used as the robust gate because it retains banned lexical/length/position features

shortcut_policy.future_or_gold: resolved, judgement, final judge prompt and any outcome text are masked or never read; outcome is target only

shortcut_policy.role_name: message role and named agent identity are not feature values; only parsed action signatures are retained
shortcut_policy.task_id: task key/hash is used only for grouping, split and reference lookup; never a feature
shortcut_policy.error_word: observation content is not used by clean methods
shortcut_policy.length: raw action count, reference length, length difference and duration are not features
shortcut_policy.position: prefix fraction and explicit position match are not features; the clean representation is a normalized action-class histogram, and cross-task-group assignment is the negative control

cost_contract.candidate_count: one model and four fixed prefixes per method
cost_contract.training_budget: same 5-fold ridge fit, same calibration FPR target, same L2 and same number of prefix observations for every clean method
cost_contract.inference_budget: offline feature extraction only; no additional model/API calls
cost_contract.retry_policy: no retries after a valid run; failed execution is reported and does not trigger an unregistered design change

metrics_and_gate.go_status: REPRODUCED_ROBUST_GO only if historical replay reproduces data counts and direction; clean_paired_reference beats clean_no_reference (and every stronger fair no-reference method) by >=10% relative; task-group paired bootstrap CI lower > 0; all three frozen seeds point the same way; cross-group/deletion controls remove or materially weaken the gain; all leakage/budget audits pass
metrics_and_gate.positive_not_go: any real clean positive signal that misses one or more GO checks
metrics_and_gate.stop_scope: if no gain, stop only this exact clean representation; retain historical E29 positive result and state the absolute reason. This is not a direction-level method NO-GO and does not count as a third substantive failure.

prohibited: do not tune features, thresholds, seeds, split, metrics or methods after seeing results
do not call historical E29 GO a robust GO
do not treat same-data subsets as confirmation
do not add a third module or use an LLM/API to rescue a failed clean representation

scope.absolute_stop_scope: 若纯结构实现没有真实提升，只停止本次去错误词与长度的固定结构输入；不否定 Exp85 的部分正向结果，不触发方向 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。

original_reproduction.source_hash_rule: 所有绑定 E33 源文件必须逐字节匹配；Exp85 aggregate 必须声明 original_replay.byte_identical=true；Exp85 confirmation replay 必须匹配其历史 SHA-256。

single_diagnostic.name: pure_anonymous_structure_bridge
single_diagnostic.hypothesis: 如果 E85 的责任桥提升不依赖错误/验证/重试词、错误标记、字符串长度、消息/动作数量或活动量，那么固定的纯匿名结构输入加 OOS 责任概率 bridge，应相对同样结构局部基线保持正向提升。

input_contract.role: 每条轨迹按首次出现顺序映射为 role_0、role_1、...；原始 role 只用于建立映射和训练标签，不进入特征或 tie-break。
input_contract.task_id_domain: task 与 domain 清空；conv_id 替换为 opaque id；task_group 仅用于切分、分组 bootstrap 和审计。
input_contract.allowed_information: 仅使用字段是否存在、JSON 是否可解析、JSON 顶层类型、匿名结构树的有限嵌套/arity 桶、匿名结构签名的重复率/多样性率；所有字符串值和对象键名均丢弃。
forbidden_information: 任何错误、失败、验证、重试、拒绝等词或词面 token
原始字符串长度、token 数、字符数
turn/action 数、绝对活动量、角色消息绝对数量
位置、index、first/last、recency 作为方法输入
mistake_agent 和 mistake_step 作为输入；它们仅用于 train 标签和最终评分
input_contract.e1_feature_definition: 所有 *_rate 与 *_diversity/repeat 都是角色自身轨迹消息上的比例；不保留任何分母对应的绝对计数。JSON 结构签名只保留匿名类型、有限嵌套深度和 arity 桶，不保留键名或字符串值。

e2_local_contract.allowed_step_features: 与 E1 相同的结构布尔量/有限结构形状布尔量在单步上的值；可使用该轨迹的结构重复/多样性率，不读取词、长度或 index。
e2_local_contract.bridge: full 只在 local score 上额外加入固定 3.0 * OOS 匿名责任概率；no_bridge/delete 的 prior=0。
e2_local_contract.tie_break: 仅使用 role_0 等匿名角色和当前匿名结构签名的 SHA-256；不使用 index、原始内容 hash 或原始 role/tool 名。完全相同的结构签名视为不可区分并使用平均并列名次。
e2_local_contract.shuffle: 每条 confirmation 轨迹内确定性置换匿名角色概率到匿名角色的映射，保留概率多重集、输入和调用预算；置换种子由实验 seed 与匿名结构摘要决定。

split_and_oos.official_test_exclusion: 沿用 E33/E85 loader，排除官方 test conv_id 及其 task_group；其余按 sha1(task_group + '|group6-confirm-v1') % 5 == 0 进入 confirm，其余 train。
split_and_oos.bridge: full 只使用 train task_group 训练的 logistic model 对 confirm task_group 预测；train 内保留 5-fold task_group OOF 审计。
leakage_assertions: train task_group 与 confirm task_group 交集为 0
full bridge 预测记录集合等于 confirm 评分记录集合
训练 task_group 与预测 task_group 不相交
模型输入不含原始 task、domain、conv_id、task_group、role、tool name、gold

conditions.deletion: no_bridge_delete 将 role prior 固定为 0，仍使用完全相同的结构分数、数据和调用预算。
conditions.recency: 只作为预注册的外部强基线报告，不是纯结构方法的输入；纯结构 full/local/no_bridge 不读取位置。

statistics.ci: task_group paired bootstrap 95% percentile CI of per-group MRR delta

decision.robust_go: REPRODUCED_FULLY_DESHORTCUT_GO iff Exp85 input/result hashes match; full_structural beats strongest local/no_bridge/recency by >=10% relative; paired task_group CI lower >0; three seeds direction-consistent; deletion and role-probability shuffle remove or materially reduce bridge gain; all leakage/purity/budget checks pass.
decision.positive_not_go: 任何无错误、同预算的 full_structural 正增益但未同时满足全部门槛，记 POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO，保留方向继续确认。
decision.exact_stop: 若 pure_structure_method 相对最强公平基线没有真实正增益，停止的绝对对象是本次固定纯结构输入和固定权重，不是 Exp85 历史实现；这只排除‘去错误词与长度后仍由当前纯结构 bridge 实现’这一机制解释。
decision.no_direction_no_go: E88 单独不能触发方向 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO；方向停止必须另有两种实质不同机制失败并经过独立复审。

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

scope.purpose: 针对 Exp86 中成功参照在第三个 seed 上成功误报率超过 10% 的具体原因，检验一个且仅一个新机制：只在当前前缀与候选成功参照的匿名动作类别分布足够可比时使用 paired-reference scorer，否则回退到同一 clean_no_reference scorer。
scope.research_question: 参照的可比性选择门能否在不增加候选、模型或 API 预算的情况下保留同任务成功参照的召回增益并把成功误报率控制到 0.10 以下？
scope.failure_to_address: Exp86 clean_paired_reference 的参照信息总体有效，但 seed 20260825 的 success FPR=0.1326623971；跨任务参照也有 0.1784--0.2498 FPR。该实验不把这一现象解释为方法方向失败，而只测试可比性条件化是否能隔离不匹配参照。
scope.absolute_stop_policy: 若结果没有正增益，停止对象只能是本文件冻结的 comparison-score、有限阈值选择、双模型回退和指标门组合；硬证据必须是外层 test 上 gated_paired 相对预登记的最强公平风险基线无正向召回差，或门控未降低风险且随机覆盖对照同样表现。该结论不否定 Exp86 的 paired-reference 正信号、不否定成功参照方向，也不触发方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO；仍保留所有无错误正增益，并只设计下一最小机制。
scope.no_go_rule: Exp89 单独不能触发方向级 NO-GO。方向级停止至少需要同一冻结研究目标的三种理论实质不同机制失败、每次均通过数据/Harness/预算审计，并经独立复审。

data_and_units.primary_unit: failure trajectory for recall/FPR; task group for outer split and paired bootstrap
data_and_units.deduplication: global parsed interaction trace SHA-256, identical to Exp86; conflicting duplicate labels invalidate the run
data_and_units.fold_assignment: sha256(seed + '|outer|' + normalized_task) modulo 5; all rows of one normalized task stay together
data_and_units.calibration: inside each outer train partition, calibration task groups satisfy sha256(seed + '|calibration|' + normalized_task) modulo 5 == 0; calibration rows are excluded from both model fits; only train/calibration may choose thresholds
data_and_units.test_seal: outer test groups are read only for final scoring; no test comparability quantile, gate coverage, alarm threshold, outcome, or method choice is used

single_mechanism.name: reference_comparability_selective_gate
single_mechanism.hypothesis: 如果失败参照的主要风险来自当前前缀与成功参照动作分布不匹配，那么基于归一化动作类别直方图的可比性门控，应在相同候选预算下相对全量 paired-reference 降低成功误报，并在外层测试中保留相对 clean_no_reference 的召回增益；若参照可比性并非原因，门控应不优于同覆盖随机门。
single_mechanism.observable_input: 当前 prefix 与每个候选 reference 的 normalized action-class histogram；每个候选用 cosine similarity 与归一化 Jensen-Shannon distribution similarity 合成一个 [0,1] comparability score，门值为候选中的最大 score。
single_mechanism.comparability_formula: max_reference 0.5*cosine(current_hist, reference_hist) + 0.5*(1 - JSD(current_hist, reference_hist)/ln(2)); zero histograms receive score 0
forbidden_inputs: task text or normalized task tokens
task ID, run ID, task hash as a model feature
error/failure/resolved/judgement/final-judge words or outcome
raw action count, raw/reference length, length difference, duration
prefix fraction, absolute position, first/last index
role name, tool name, observation text, reference result/outcome
Gold labels or future events
single_mechanism.decision: if comparability >= selected outer-fold gate threshold, use paired-reference ridge score; otherwise use independently fitted clean_no_reference ridge score
single_mechanism.deletion: no_reference is the explicit deletion/fallback method; ungated paired_reference is retained to show the unconditioned effect

nested_threshold_contract.gate_threshold_candidates: Only the pre-frozen quantile grid [0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90] of train-partition comparability scores plus an all-references sentinel -1.0 (comparability is in [0,1]) may be considered. Quantiles are calculated without labels from outer-train rows and are never calculated on outer-test rows.
nested_threshold_contract.gate_selection: For each candidate gate threshold, compute calibration-row gated scores using the model fit only on non-calibration outer-train groups. Select the candidate with maximum calibration failure recall subject to calibration success FPR <= 0.10 and prefix-opportunity gate coverage >= 0.10. Ties resolve by lower calibration FPR, then higher coverage, then stricter (higher) threshold.
nested_threshold_contract.alarm_threshold: For the selected gate, choose the lowest observed calibration-success maximum score whose alarms are <= 0.10, using calibration successes only; if no candidate is admissible use the conservative nextafter(max_score,+infinity).
nested_threshold_contract.coverage: gate coverage is the fraction of all fixed prefix opportunities for which a candidate reference is used; the same learned gate threshold is used for paired and cross-group controls.
nested_threshold_contract.random_control: For each outer fold, independently hash (seed, fold, run_id, prefix) and select exactly the nearest integer number of prefix opportunities matching the selected paired-gate calibration coverage. The random gate uses the paired/no-reference scores and its own calibration-success alarm threshold; no outcome or test metric determines the random selection.
nested_threshold_contract.cross_group_control: For test rows, replace each same-task reference list with a deterministic donor list from a different task group in the same outer partition, preserving candidate count. Apply the selected paired gate threshold unchanged; donor task/group is never a feature.

conditions.clean_no_reference: current-prefix normalized action histogram only; strongest no-reference fallback comparator
conditions.reference_deletion: exact alias of clean_no_reference, reported to make deletion explicit
conditions.ungated_paired_reference: Exp86 clean_paired_reference feature contract, no gate
conditions.gated_paired_reference: paired-reference scorer when comparability passes, clean_no_reference scorer otherwise
conditions.gated_cross_group_reference: same gate and same paired scorer, but reference donors are from a different task group within the test partition
conditions.random_coverage_gate: same paired/no-reference scorers and calibration target coverage, with pre-frozen hash-random gate
conditions.historical_fail_fast: read-only historical Exp29 report; not a clean fair method and not eligible to replace clean baselines

budget_contract.candidate_count: one ridge model per representation and four fixed prefixes per trajectory; gate adds no candidate or API call
budget_contract.models: paired and no-reference ridge fits use identical rows, prefixes, L2=8.0 and class weighting; only input representation differs
budget_contract.retry_policy: after a valid result, no redesign, new feature, threshold grid, seed or metric is allowed

metrics_and_gate.primary: failure alarm recall at success false-positive rate <= 0.10
metrics_and_gate.alarm_event_rule: An alarm is the first score at or above the fold threshold at a fixed observed prefix fraction >= 0.20; 0.20 is inherited from Exp86 as an evaluation rule, is not a tunable feature or threshold, and is identical for every method.
metrics_and_gate.strongest_fair_baseline: per seed, among clean_no_reference, ungated_paired_reference and random_coverage_gate, choose the highest-recall method whose test success FPR <= 0.10; historical_fail_fast is never used for this eligibility choice
metrics_and_gate.nested_oof_feasibility_go: NESTED_OOF_FEASIBILITY_GO iff (1) gated_paired_reference test FPR <=0.10 for each seed; (2) its recall is >=10% relative to the per-seed strongest fair risk-eligible baseline for each seed; (3) task-group paired bootstrap CI lower >0 for gated_paired vs that baseline for each seed; (4) all three seed deltas are positive; (5) gated_paired beats same-coverage random_control in recall and paired CI lower >0 for each seed; (6) gated_cross_group gain over clean_no_reference is absent or at least 50% weaker than paired gain for every seed; (7) all data, leakage, split and budget audits pass.
metrics_and_gate.positive_not_go: Any real, same-budget, no-leakage positive result that misses one or more GO checks is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO and must retain the observed signal and the exact failed gate; it is not a STOP or direction NO-GO.
metrics_and_gate.exact_stop: The result status STOP_EXACT_REFERENCE_COMPARABILITY_GATE is allowed only if gated_paired has no positive recall delta against every risk-eligible fair baseline in every seed, or its apparent positive is no better than same-coverage random gate. The absolute evidence must be recorded in results: seed-level deltas, FPR, coverage, bootstrap CIs and random-control comparison. The stop excludes only 'this comparability gate as frozen'; it retains Exp86, any local positives and the next smallest mechanism question.

prohibited: do not inspect or use outer-test outcomes to choose gate/alarm thresholds
do not tune the quantile grid, feature formula, model, seeds, split or metric after results
do not use task text/ID/length/position/error words to rescue the gate
do not add a third module or LLM/API call
do not call a positive-not-GO result a final confirmation or paper GO
do not reclassify an exact implementation STOP as direction NO-GO

facts.tie_break_audit.interpretation: 当前固定 tie key 为 anonymous role + anonymous structural signature；没有坐标、索引或原文，但在完全结构并列时 generic_role token 会决定确定性次序。该次序敏感性影响绝对并列分数，却不改变 full/deletion 的零差异。

facts.gate_flags.deletion_or_shuffle_support.r: full/deletion/shuffle 的 MRR、R@1、R@3 完全相同，删除或置乱没有造成下降。
facts.gate_flags.e1_or_ablation_support.reason: E1 full=0.0、最强 baseline=1.0，且 deletion/shuffle 不降低分数。
facts.gate_flags.eligibility.reason: 196 eligible rows、104 task groups 均达到 100 门槛。
facts.gate_flags.leakage_and_budget.reason: Gold/坐标/注入字段/原身份均未进入 method turns，api_calls=0、token_calls=0、总字节在 20MiB 内；原始 false 是把数值零误当布尔失败。
facts.synthetic_test.evidence: 两角色结构相同时，把 generic_role_1 的先验设为 1、generic_role_0 设为 0，full 首位变为 role_1；删除责任桥后排序与 full 不同。

design_boundary.one_minimal_mechanism: 在既有匿名结构局部评分与责任概率桥上只增加一个 state_transition 结构量：相邻事件的匿名 input/output/tool-call/phase 结构状态是否发生变化。没有词法、错误词、字符串长度、绝对位置或第三模块。
design_boundary.absolute_stop_rule: 若修正后的分层六页仍未达到 100 条 eligible 或 100 个 task groups，只停止本次分层 external evaluation object qualification；绝对证据必须限定为该分层页的行/组计数。已有 887 行中的 312 条/235 组证明资产总体不是空的，因此该停止不能升级为全资产 STOP，更不能记方法 NO-GO。
design_boundary.method_stop_rule: 若达到资格后 full bridge 相对最强公平基线没有真实正增益，只停止固定 adapter+纯结构 state-transition+固定 AFTraj 权重这一实现；排除的是该冻结机制，不排除历史 bridge 正向、其他数据域或其他实质机制。

decision.HARNESS_INVALID: Any source revision, overlap, Gold isolation, adapter, metric, or budget audit failure; no scientific interpretation.

scope.purpose: 承接 Exp86/Exp89 的 paired-reference 真实正信号，只检验一个新机制：在每个外层训练折内，使用独立校准成功任务组的有限样本单侧 95% Clopper--Pearson 上界选择报警阈值，使任务组 any-alarm 风险而不是仅行级经验误报率受到保守控制。
scope.research_question: 有限校准成功任务组的 CP 风险上界能否在不增加候选、模型、特征或 API 预算的情况下保留 paired-reference 的失败报警召回，并将测试行级 FPR 与任务组 any-alarm FPR 控制到 0.10 以下？
scope.failure_to_address: Exp89 的 comparability gate 在三个 seed 均覆盖 100%，未改变 Exp86 paired-reference；seed 20260825 的测试 success row-FPR 为 0.1326623971。该实验只处理有限样本经验校准过于乐观的问题，不把它解释为成功参照方向失败。
scope.statistical_feasibility: 单侧 Clopper--Pearson 上界为 Beta^{-1}(0.95; k+1, n-k)，其中 n 为校准成功任务组数、k 为发生任一 success run 报警的组数；k=0、k=n 和 n=0 均有明确边界，候选阈值有限且含无报警兜底。
scope.absolute_stop_policy: 若 CP 风险校准导致当前冻结表示在外层测试中没有任何公平正向增益，或只能无报警且零召回，STOP 仅针对‘success-task-group CP threshold calibration + Exp89 representation’这一冻结机制。绝对证据必须包含三 seed 的阈值、校准 n/k/上界、测试 row/group FPR、召回与配对 bootstrap；不得否定 Exp86/Exp89 的 paired-reference 正信号，不得升级为方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。
scope.no_go_rule: Exp91 单独不能触发成功参照方向级 NO-GO；方向级停止仍需同一冻结目标下三种实质不同且公平的方法机制失败，并完成独立复核。

single_mechanism.name: finite_sample_task_group_risk_bound_calibration
single_mechanism.hypothesis: 经验行级 10% 阈值在少量成功任务组上可能低估‘一个组内任一成功轨迹报警’的风险；使用校准成功任务组的单侧 95% CP 上界选最低可接受报警阈值，应比经验阈值更保守地控制 group-any FPR，并在 paired-reference 信号真实时仍保留相对无参照的召回增益。
single_mechanism.observable_input: 与 Exp89 完全相同的匿名 normalized action-class histogram 及其成功参照结构特征；新机制只改变报警阈值的有限样本风险校准，不加入新特征。
single_mechanism.risk_event: 对一个候选报警阈值，校准成功任务组的 Bernoulli 事件为：该组中是否存在任一 success run 在固定前缀 >= 0.20 报警；k 为报警组数，n 为校准中至少包含一条 success run 的独立任务组数。测试 group-any FPR 使用同一定义，分母为外层测试中至少包含一条 success run 的独立任务组数。
single_mechanism.cp_formula: upper_95(k,n) = Beta^{-1}(0.95; k+1, n-k); n=0 返回 1.0，k=0 使用同一 Beta 分位数边界，k=n 返回 1.0。
single_mechanism.threshold_candidates: 仅允许校准成功行的 max(score over fixed prefixes) 值及其 math.nextafter(value,+inf)，去重后升序；不使用 calibration failure、outer test、任务文本、ID 或任何 Gold。
single_mechanism.threshold_selection: 按分数阈值从低到高选择第一个 CP upper_95 <= 0.10 的候选；若无候选满足，选择预登记的 NO_ALARM（所有行不报警）而不是改用测试结果。
single_mechanism.deletion: reference_deletion_risk_bound 与 clean_no_reference_risk_bound 必须严格使用同一分数和同一阈值，作为删除等价审计。

metrics_and_gate.primary: failure alarm recall at success row-FPR <= 0.10
required_secondary: success task-group any-alarm FPR and denominator
calibration task-group count, alarm-group count and CP upper bound
metrics_and_gate.strongest_fair_baseline: All methods and predictions are frozen before any test result is read. For the final pre-registered comparator report, determine methods among clean_no_reference_empirical, reference_deletion_empirical, paired_reference_empirical and clean_no_reference_risk_bound whose test row-FPR is <=0.10 in all three seeds. Choose one global method with highest mean recall across the three seeds (fixed deterministic tie order: clean_no_reference_risk_bound, paired_reference_empirical, clean_no_reference_empirical, reference_deletion_empirical). Test results may establish final eligibility and report this frozen comparator, but cannot feed back into threshold, method, model, feature or baseline redesign. Historical Fail-Fast is never eligible.
metrics_and_gate.risk_control_feasibility_go: RISK_CONTROL_FEASIBILITY_GO iff (1) paired_reference_risk_bound test row-FPR <=0.10 in all seeds; (2) its recall is >=10% relative to the one globally selected risk-qualified fair baseline in every seed; (3) task-group paired bootstrap CI lower >0 against that baseline in every seed and all deltas are positive; (4) reference_deletion_risk_bound is exactly clean_no_reference_risk_bound; (5) paired group-any FPR <=0.10 in all seeds; (6) all data, leakage, split, threshold and budget audits pass.
metrics_and_gate.positive_not_go: Any real same-budget no-leakage positive that misses one or more GO checks is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO. This includes positive recall with CP group-any FPR >0.10, positive recall with CI crossing 0, or a conservative no-alarm fold. It is never a direction STOP.
metrics_and_gate.exact_stop: STOP_EXACT_CP_RISK_CALIBRATION is allowed only when every fair comparison has no positive recall delta in every seed, or CP always selects NO_ALARM with zero recall and no residual positive signal; results must contain seed-level metrics, calibration n/k/upper bounds, thresholds, CIs, better/worse/tie and deletion equality. The stop excludes only this finite-sample CP mechanism.

prohibited: do not inspect outer-test outcomes to choose any threshold, feature, model or method; after all methods are frozen, test outcomes may only be used for the pre-registered three-seed risk eligibility and global comparator report
do not tune the confidence level, candidate construction, model, seeds, split or metric after results
do not use task text/ID/length/position/error words to rescue CP calibration
do not add a third module or LLM/API call
do not call a positive-not-GO result a final confirmation or paper GO
do not reclassify an exact implementation STOP as direction NO-GO

complete_config.title: 成功参照任务组 split-conformal 边际风险校准可行性

scope.purpose: 承接 Exp86、Exp89、Exp91 的 paired-reference 正向信号，只检验一个理论不同的新机制：任务组 split-conformal marginal risk quantile。它用校准成功任务组的组最大分数直接确定边际报警分位数，不引入新模型、特征、候选、任务或 API。
scope.research_question: 在同一冻结表示、模型、前缀、任务组切分和零 API 预算下，任务组 split-conformal 分位数能否相对风险合格的全局公平基线保留 paired-reference 的 failure recall 提升，并使 success row-FPR 与 task-group any-alarm FPR 均不超过 0.10？
scope.previous_positive_signal: Exp91 paired CP 相对全局公平基线三个 seed 的 failure recall 差均为正（+2.642、+1.829、+7.317 个百分点），但前两个任务组 paired bootstrap CI 下界跨 0；Exp91 的单侧 CP 上界在每个 outer fold 只允许 0--1 个校准报警组，风险预算可能未充分利用。
scope.failure_to_address: 仅处理 Exp91 单侧 CP 上界过于保守、校准风险预算未充分利用的问题；不把 Exp91 的 CI 不足解释为 paired-reference 方向失败。
scope.exact_stop_policy: 若该固定 group-max conformal quantile+tiebreak 实现在所有预注册公平比较中没有任何真实正向召回，或始终选择 NO_ALARM 且零召回，STOP 只针对这一固定共形阈值机制。绝对证据必须包含三个 seed 的 n、k、q、threshold、tie 计数、row/group FPR、recall、任务组 bootstrap CI、better/worse/tie 和删除等价审计；不得否定 Exp86、Exp89、Exp91 的正信号，不得升级为成功参照方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。
scope.no_go_rule: Exp92 单独不能触发成功参照方向级 NO-GO；方向级停止仍须同一冻结目标下三种实质不同且公平的机制失败并完成独立复核。任何公平同预算正提升但未过全部 GO 门均为 POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO。

data_and_units.calibration: inside each outer train partition, calibration task groups satisfy sha256(seed + '|calibration|' + normalized_task) modulo 5 == 0; calibration rows are excluded from both model fits; only calibration success rows choose empirical, CP anchor or conformal thresholds
data_and_units.test_seal: outer test groups are read only for final scoring; no outer-test outcome, FPR, group event, threshold, method or baseline choice is used during calibration

single_mechanism.name: task_group_split_conformal_marginal_risk_quantile
single_mechanism.hypothesis: Exp91 的 CP 上界在每个校准折只允许 0--1 个报警组，可能过度保守；在相同校准成功任务组上直接取 group-max score 的 split-conformal marginal quantile，并用严格 nextafter 处理 ties，应在不放宽预注册测试风险门的情况下恢复更多 failure recall。
single_mechanism.observable_input: 与 Exp89/Exp91 完全相同的匿名 normalized action-class histogram 及既有成功参照结构特征；新机制只把校准组风险估计从 CP 上界改为 split-conformal group-max quantile，不加入新特征。
single_mechanism.group_score: 一个 calibration success task group 的 score 是该组所有 success runs、所有固定 prefixes [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8] 的预测分数最大值；不能使用 calibration failure、Gold、测试结果或未来事件。
single_mechanism.quantile_rule: 固定 alpha=0.10；n 为 calibration success task group 数，k=ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))；若 k>n 则选择 NO_ALARM；否则 q 为 n 个 group score 升序后的第 k 个值（1-based），部署 threshold=math.nextafter(q,+inf)，报警规则为 score>q，从而 ties 不报警。
single_mechanism.finite_sample_scope: 这是交换性假设下的有限样本边际 task-group any-alarm 风险构造；不宣称条件风险上界、不宣称任意单个任务风险受控、不把 q 当作 95% CP 上界。
single_mechanism.deletion: reference_deletion_conformal 必须严格 alias clean_no_reference_conformal，使用同一 score、q、threshold、predictions 和 metrics。

metrics_and_gate.primary: failure alarm recall at success row-FPR <= 0.10
required_secondary: success task-group any-alarm FPR and denominator
per-fold calibration n, k, q, threshold and tie count
metrics_and_gate.strongest_fair_baseline: After all predictions and methods are frozen, qualify pre-registered clean_no_reference_empirical, reference_deletion_empirical (its exact alias), clean_no_reference_conformal, clean_no_reference_cp, paired_reference_cp and paired_reference_empirical only if both test row-FPR <=0.10 and task-group any-alarm FPR <=0.10 in all three seeds. Select one global method with highest mean failure recall across the three seeds using deterministic tie order [clean_no_reference_empirical, reference_deletion_empirical, clean_no_reference_conformal, clean_no_reference_cp, paired_reference_cp, paired_reference_empirical]. Never switch comparator by seed and never count an exact deletion alias as an additional independent signal. Test results may establish final eligibility and report the frozen comparator only; they cannot feed back into threshold, model, feature, mechanism or baseline redesign. Historical Fail-Fast never qualifies.
metrics_and_gate.group_conformal_feasibility_go: GROUP_CONFORMAL_FEASIBILITY_GO iff paired_reference_conformal has test row-FPR <=0.10 and task-group any-alarm FPR <=0.10 in all three seeds; its failure recall has positive difference and >=10% relative gain over the one globally selected risk-qualified fair baseline in every seed; paired task-group bootstrap CI lower >0 against that baseline in every seed; reference_deletion_conformal is exactly clean_no_reference_conformal and paired conformal is better than deletion in every seed; all data, leakage, split, threshold and budget audits pass.
metrics_and_gate.positive_not_go: Any real same-budget no-leakage positive that misses one or more GO checks is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO. This includes a positive recall with CI crossing 0, positive recall with one risk gate missed, or a cross-group control that also improves. It is never a direction STOP.
metrics_and_gate.exact_stop: STOP_EXACT_GROUP_CONFORMAL_QUANTILE is allowed only when every fair comparison has no positive recall delta in every seed, or conformal always selects NO_ALARM with zero recall and no residual positive signal; results must contain all prescribed seed/fold metrics, CIs, better/worse/tie and alias checks. The stop excludes only this fixed group-max conformal quantile+tiebreak implementation.

prohibited: Do not inspect outer-test outcomes to choose any threshold, feature, model, mechanism or baseline.

complete_config.purpose: Test one conditional routing mechanism on the already-consumed Exp63/Exp70 assets: route from fewer_explicit_errors to the frozen structural score only when the baseline is tied and the frozen OOF structural margin clears one pre-registered threshold.

mechanism.eligibility: x and y explicit failure counts are exactly equal
mechanism.structural_prediction: the frozen Exp63 LogisticRegression prediction from the Exp70 scorer
mechanism.routing: use structural prediction only when eligible and absolute margin is at least the selected threshold; otherwise use Base
mechanism.deleted_A_contract: when A is deleted, Base+G must return Base for every row, so no structural prediction is available to the gate

threshold_selection.quantile_source: all 361 Exp63 UUID-GroupKFold OOF rows, before applying the Exp70 routing eligibility mask
threshold_selection.utility: mean over UUIDs of (gated accuracy - Base accuracy), with all OOF rows for a UUID kept in one cluster
threshold_selection.coverage: routed rows divided by all OOF rows; candidate must be at least 0.10
selection_order: if tied, prefer the larger threshold; no-margin is least conservative

evaluation.source: the already-consumed Exp70 planning_single_hard confirmation rows only
evaluation.orientation_algorithm: random.Random(seed).random() < 0.5 in source order; chosen-first label=1 and reject-first label=0
matrices: Base+A frozen structural model on all rows
Base+G with A deleted (must equal Base row by row)
evaluation.random_gate: for each seed, deterministic SHA-256 seeded ranking of eligible row indices; select exactly the same count as the selected structural gate and route those rows to the frozen structural prediction

paired_uuid_bootstrap.ci: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 over UUID-cluster macro deltas, with all three orientation seeds pooled within each UUID

stage1_decision.continue_gate: Exp63 OOF and Exp70 extrapolation Base+A+G point estimates are both positive relative to Base; at least three seed directions agree or pooled UUID better exceeds worse; deletion equivalence, leakage, and budget audits pass
stage1_decision.interpretation: A stage1 stop retires only this fixed threshold/routing mechanism and preserves any conditional or local positive signal; it is not a direction-level method NO-GO.

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

data_and_split.train_definition: pool task_group not assigned to SHA1(task_group + '|group6-confirm-v1') % 5 == 0

method.base: E88 local structural score with fixed weights
method.always_bridge: E88 local score + 3.0 * strict OOS anonymous responsibility probability
method.selective: use always_bridge iff ranking_change and responsibility_margin >= selected threshold; otherwise local

method.ranking_change: full and local anonymous tied-rank orderings differ; computed without Gold

nested_oof.model_fit: outer-held predictions use one model fit on all outer-train rows after threshold is frozen

statistics.comparison: selective vs strongest global fair baseline among local, always_bridge, recency, and controls

decision.continue_qualification: selective is truly positive versus strongest fair global baseline in the three-seed average with at least two seeds positive and no negative seed below -0.01, or all three seeds positive; it must beat matched-random and shuffled controls on average, be neither all-accept nor all-reject, and pass audits
decision.positive_not_go: any audit-clean positive signal that does not satisfy all continuation gates is retained as POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO_STAGE1
decision.exact_stop: only if every fair comparison has no positive signal, or the gate degenerates on every outer fold and cannot change ranking; verdict STOP_EXP94_FIXED_MARGIN_GATE_ONLY
decision.confirmation_authorization: stage1 must stop before evaluating the 180 confirmation records; a later locked replay requires explicit authorization

complete_config.title: 责任主体组内 Pairwise 候选排序：纯匿名结构责任桥阶段 1

scope.purpose: 在 E88 固定纯匿名结构输入和 E2 局部排序上，只改变 E1 的评价对象：以每条轨迹内 Gold 角色对非 Gold 角色的组内差分学习替代逐角色独立二分类，检验责任候选排序是否改善责任桥。
scope.research_question: 在完全相同的纯结构特征、task_group OOF、零 API 预算和 E2 固定权重下，groupwise pairwise responsibility bridge 是否优于 E88 original bridge 及 local/recency 公平基线？
scope.failure_to_address: E88/E94/E95 的逐角色责任概率或其下游门控没有证明可继续提升；E1 的标签实际是每轨迹恰有一个责任角色的组内选择，独立二分类目标可能与部署时组内排序不匹配。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 若 pairwise bridge 在本阶段所有公平比较均无真实正向信号，且 E1 也不优于 original A，则只停止固定的组内 pairwise responsibility 实现；不停止 E88 原始桥、E85/E88 历史正向信号，不直接写方向 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。
scope.no_go_rule: 本实验是同一冻结责任桥目标的第三种实质机制；若阶段 1 无进展，只记录 MODULE_NOT_VALIDATED_GROUPWISE_E1 并提交独立复审，不把阶段 1 结果直接扩大成方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。

data_and_split.loader: AFTraj load_aftraj; remove official test conv_ids and all task_groups overlapping official test before train/confirmation assignment

input_contract.inherits: E88 pure anonymous structure feature contract byte-for-byte through read-only runner
input_contract.allowed: E88 25 anonymous structural rate/diversity/repeat features, within-trajectory role normalization
forbidden: Gold fields except training pair construction and final scoring
input_contract.role_anonymization: first appearance in each trajectory -> role_0, role_1, ...
input_contract.tie_break: anonymous role plus anonymous structural SHA-256; no original role, index, Gold, or raw content

methods.base: E88 fixed local structural step score
methods.original_A: E88逐角色 independent logistic bridge; source fit_logreg defaults unchanged (epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=3.0), fitted only on outer-train task_groups
methods.pairwise_B: for every outer-train trajectory and every Gold/non-Gold role pair, add x_gold-x_neg,label=1 and x_neg-x_gold,label=0; source fit_logreg fixed epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=1.0; no threshold or regularization search
methods.pairwise_inference: role utility=w dot x with bias omitted because it cancels within a trajectory; stable softmax across roles; exact probability ties use anonymous role/structure tie key
methods.shuffled_control: within each held trajectory deterministically permute B's anonymous role probabilities, preserving probability multiset and budget
methods.global_comparator: max(local, original_A, recency), selected once by three-seed average MRR; never switch per seed

oos_and_statistics.outer_oos: for each seed, split 731 task_groups into five folds; fit A and B only on outer-train and score only outer-held; concatenate each record once as strict OOF
oos_and_statistics.bootstrap: task_group paired bootstrap percentile 95% CI, 5000 resamples, on per-task_group mean reciprocal rank

decision.continue_qualification: pairwise B vs fixed global comparator has positive three-seed average, at least 2/3 seeds positive with negative seed >= -0.01pp or all 3 positive; pairwise E1 top1 is not below original A; shuffled control does not attain B; deletion equals local; all audits pass
decision.continue_to_locked_replay: only if stage-1 pairwise B reaches >=10% relative vs fixed global comparator and task_group CI lower >0 in all three seeds; then write CONTINUE_TO_LOCKED_HISTORICAL_REPLAY, never GO directly
decision.positive_not_go: any audit-clean positive direction that fails a final stage-1 gate is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO_STAGE1
decision.module_not_validated: if B <= A in all three seeds and B E1 top1 does not improve over A, write MODULE_NOT_VALIDATED_GROUPWISE_E1; stop only this pairwise implementation and trigger independent review
decision.exact_stop: if no fair comparison has any true positive and E1 condition above fails, write MODULE_NOT_VALIDATED_GROUPWISE_E1
decision.final_go: forbidden in this stage; no confirmation scoring or final paper claim

scope.purpose: 在 Exp96 只用 731 条开发记录固定的 pairwise_B 上，进行一次未参与模型拟合、阈值选择或方法选择的 180 条历史 confirmation 锁定复跑，检验 soft responsibility distribution 是否能改善 E2 下游步骤排序。

scope.absolute_stop_scope: 任何 STOP 只停止本次固定 pairwise_B 在该 confirmation 边界上的外推，不停止 E88、E85、Exp96 的正向信号，不写 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。

methods.strongest_comparator: original_A fixed by Exp96 development average; no confirmation re-selection
methods.local: E88 fixed local structural step score
methods.original_A: E88 independent logistic bridge; fit on all 731 train records only, source defaults epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=3.0
methods.pairwise_B: Exp96 exact pairwise utility: every train trajectory Gold/non-Gold pair contributes x_gold-x_non_gold,label=1 and reverse,label=0; source fit_logreg epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=1.0; within-trajectory stable softmax; bridge_weight=3.0
methods.shuffled_B: deterministically permute pairwise role probability values within each confirmation trajectory, preserving the probability multiset and budget

decision.primary_comparison: pairwise_B minus fixed original_A on E2 MRR
decision.LOCKED_CONFIRMATION_FEASIBILITY_GO: all three seeds have positive E2 MRR delta, every seed task_group paired CI lower > 0, deletion equals local, shuffled_B does not attain pairwise_B, and all audits pass; this is the second experiment-level feasibility GO, not a final paper GO
decision.CONFIRMED_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO: all three seeds positive but any CI crosses 0, or at least 2/3 positive with any negative seed no smaller than -0.01 percentage point; retain the signal and do not STOP
decision.LOCKED_CONFIRMATION_INCONCLUSIVE: mixed or unstable direction without clear negative evidence; do not direction-STOP
decision.STOP_EXP97_EXACT_PAIRWISE_CONFIRMATION_O: only if all three seed deltas are non-positive, or pooled task_group CI upper <= 0, and no asset/harness problem; stop only this fixed confirmation extrapolation
decision.asset_or_harness_failure: BLOCKED or HARNESS_INVALID, never a method STOP
decision.final_paper_gate: preserve final >=10% relative, CI lower >0, and external-agent gate; not tested or claimed here

order: read confirmation Gold once for final scoring

scope.purpose: 在 Exp97 锁定且完全不改动的 pairwise_B 上，使用从未被 Exp96/Exp97 评分的 AFTraj official test_unsafe 163 条记录做一次独立压力验证，检验 E2 下游步骤排序提升是否继续为正。
scope.hypothesis: 在只用 731 条开发记录拟合、保持 Exp97 精确 pairwise_B 和 original_A comparator 不变的条件下，pairwise_B 在官方测试边界上的 E2 MRR 仍优于 original_A。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 任何 STOP 只停止本次固定 pairwise_B 在 official test 边界上的外推；不抹掉 Exp88、Exp96、Exp97 的正向信号，不写责任桥方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。
scope.stage_a_boundary_rule: 阶段 A 只允许读取 conv_id、task_group（由 task 的规范化 SHA-1 计算）、test-id membership、计数和摘要；不得读取 mistake_agent、mistake_step 或任何 Gold/错误字段。
scope.pre_freeze_rule: protocol.json 与 data_seal.json 先提交冻结；冻结后才实现 runner 和合成测试；只有主线程审查授权后，才允许一次官方 Gold 正式评分。

data_and_split.task_group_deoverlap: Remove every non-official unsafe record whose task_group is shared with an official test unsafe record before constructing the 731-train fit set.
data_and_split.development_split: On the 911-record pool, sha1(task_group + '|group6-confirm-v1') % 5 != 0 is the fixed 731-record train partition; % 5 == 0 is the held-out 180-record Exp97 confirmation boundary.

input_contract.inherits: Exp97 exact pairwise_B and E88 pure anonymous structure feature contract byte-for-byte
input_contract.features: E88 25 anonymous structural rate/diversity/repeat features with within-trajectory normalization
forbidden: official test Gold before final scoring
input_contract.role_anonymization: first appearance in each trajectory -> role_0, role_1, ...
input_contract.tie_break: anonymous role plus anonymous structural SHA-256; exact ties average-ranked

methods.strongest_comparator: original_A fixed by Exp96 development average; no official-test re-selection
methods.local: E88 fixed local structural step score
methods.original_A: E88 independent logistic bridge; fit only on all 731 train records, epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=3.0
methods.pairwise_B: Exp96 exact pairwise utility: every train trajectory Gold/non-Gold pair contributes x_gold-x_non_gold,label=1 and reverse,label=0; epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=1.0; within-trajectory stable softmax; bridge_weight=3.0
methods.shuffled_B: deterministically permute pairwise role probability values within each official-test trajectory, preserving probability multiset and budget

statistics.primary_metric: official test E2 task_group paired MRR

decision.primary_comparison: pairwise_B minus fixed original_A on official test E2 MRR
decision.OFFICIAL_HOLDOUT_FEASIBILITY_GO: official test 上三 seed delta 均正、每 seed task_group paired CI lower > 0、deletion=local、shuffled_B<B、审计全过；这是第二个实验级可行性 GO，不是 final paper GO。
decision.OFFICIAL_HOLDOUT_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO: 三 seed 全正但 CI 跨 0，或 2/3 正且唯一负 seed >= -0.01 percentage point；保留正信号，不 STOP。
decision.OFFICIAL_HOLDOUT_INCONCLUSIVE: 方向混合且没有清晰负证据；不做方向 STOP。
decision.STOP_EXP98_EXACT_OFFICIAL_EXTRAPOLATION_: 只有三 seed 全不正，或 pooled official-test task_group CI upper <= 0，且 Gold/Harness/资产/预算公平完整时才触发；只停止固定 pairwise_B 的 official-test 外推。
decision.asset_or_harness_failure: 缺 Gold、对象不匹配、组泄漏或资产 hash 不符归 ASSET_STOP/HARNESS_INVALID，绝不计方法失败。
decision.final_paper_gate: 最终 >=10% relative、paired CI lower >0 和真实外部 Agent/框架门仍未在本实验中宣称。

execution.stage_a: 完成：仅做 opaque boundary audit，协议和数据封存已冻结；未读取 official test Gold。
execution.stage_b: 待主线程审查后实现 runner、合成测试和 hash/泄漏审计；不得正式评分。
execution.stage_c: 仅在主线程明确授权后，以 731 train 拟合并读取 official test Gold 一次做唯一正式评分。

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

complete_config.title: 责任信号与强 Recency 底座的无参数秩融合

scope.purpose: 在 Exp96 已固定的纯匿名结构责任信号上，只增加一个无参数 RRF 秩融合机制，检验责任角色排序能否在强 recency 步排序底座上提供互补信息。
scope.hypothesis: 责任角色秩与 recency 步秩包含互补信息；固定 k=60、两路等权的 RRF 能在不依赖分数尺度和不增加 API/候选预算的情况下，优于单独 recency 及历史责任桥。
scope.mechanism_target: Exp96/97/98 中 pairwise_B 的 E2 正向信号仍弱于 official-test recency；RRF 针对的是 responsibility score 与 recency score 尺度失配，而不是重新训练责任模型。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 任何 STOP 只停止本次固定 RRF 组合；不停止 Exp88/96/97/98 的责任桥正向信号，不把组合失败扩大为责任桥方向级 TRUE_METHOD_NO_GO。
scope.pre_freeze_rule: protocol.json、data_seal.json 和合成契约测试必须先提交冻结 commit；冻结后才允许实现 runner。阶段 1 只拟合 731 条 train 记录并做 OOF；180 confirmation 与 163 official test 只做不透明边界审计，禁止读取 Gold、评分、拟合或方法选择。

input_contract.inherits: Exp96/E88 pure anonymous structure feature contract byte-for-byte through read-only runner
forbidden: confirmation or official Gold before authorized final scoring
input_contract.role_anonymization: first appearance in each trajectory -> role_0, role_1, ...
input_contract.tie_break: anonymous role plus anonymous structural SHA-256; no original role, task text, index, Gold or raw content
input_contract.e2_recency: newest step first; recency_rank = number_of_turns - step_index for a valid zero-based mistake_step; invalid step is a harness error, not a fallback

methods.base: recency: fixed newest-step-first ranking, no learned parameter
methods.local_structural: Exp88/E88 fixed local structural step score; historical comparator only
methods.pairwise_local_bridge: Exp96 exact pairwise_B: fit only outer-train task groups using Gold/non-Gold difference pairs, source fit_logreg epochs=200, lr=0.05, l2=0.001, pos_weight=1.0; within-trajectory role utility softmax; E2 bridge_weight=3.0
methods.original_A: Exp96 exact independent logistic responsibility bridge, source defaults unchanged; fit only outer-train task groups

rrf.name: reciprocal_rank_fusion
rrf.recency_rank: newest step has rank 1; next newest rank 2; etc.
rrf.responsibility_role_rank: rank anonymous roles by descending predicted probability; exact probability ties receive their average competition rank (for example positions 1 and 2 both receive 1.5); anonymous role/structural key only orders a tied block reproducibly and never splits its statistical rank; each step inherits the rank of its own role
rrf.final_step_tie: if fused scores are exactly equal, evaluation uses the average rank of the exact-score tie block; E88 anonymous step structural SHA-256 key only supplies deterministic serialization order and never splits the statistical tie
rrf.exact_probability_tie_rule: same float probability -> same average role rank; no Gold, original role, task ID or lexical field may break the statistical tie
rrf.exact_fused_score_tie_rule: same float fused score -> same average step rank; anonymous structural key is serialization-only

methods.recency_rrf_original_A: RRF(recency step rank, Exp96 original_A predicted responsibility role rank); no E2 bridge weight
methods.recency_rrf_pairwise_B: RRF(recency step rank, Exp96 pairwise_B predicted responsibility role rank); no E2 bridge weight
methods.deletion_recency: delete the responsibility rank route from B-RRF; must be byte-for-byte equivalent to recency ranking
methods.shuffled_pairwise_B_rrf: within each held trajectory deterministically permute pairwise_B anonymous role probabilities before deriving role ranks, preserving the probability multiset and all compute budget; then apply the same fixed RRF
methods.global_comparator: after all three stage-1 seed results are produced, select once by three-seed average E2 MRR from {recency, local_structural, pairwise_local_bridge, recency_rrf_original_A}; never switch comparator per seed; B-RRF is never eligible to choose its own comparator

oos_and_statistics.outer_oos: for each seed, partition the 716 train task groups into five folds; fit original_A and pairwise_B only on outer-train groups; predict every outer-held record exactly once; derive RRF only from held predictions and fixed recency ranks
required_audits: outer held group sets are disjoint and cover all 716 train groups exactly once per seed
original_A and pairwise_B predictions cover held records exactly
fit records belong only to outer-train task groups
all anonymous-role and tie keys are stable
same record count in every condition
confirmation and official Gold fields are not read in stage 1

decision.primary_comparison: recency_rrf_pairwise_B minus the single global comparator selected from the four predeclared fair baselines
decision.CONTINUE_RRF_TO_NEW_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATIO: three seeds all have positive B-RRF E2 MRR delta versus the fixed global comparator, every seed task_group paired CI lower > 0, deletion_recency=recency, shuffled_pairwise_B_rrf is below B-RRF, and all audits pass; this is only stage-1 continuation qualification, not the second GO, because the 731 groups were used for mechanism development
decision.RRF_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO: any audit-clean real positive direction, including three same-direction seeds with CI crossing 0; preserve the signal and do not STOP
decision.COMBINATION_NO_GAIN_PRESERVE_PAIRWISE_SI: B-RRF does not beat max(recency, pairwise_local_bridge) under the fixed conditions; discard only the RRF combination and retain Exp96/97/98 responsibility evidence
decision.STOP_EXP99_FIXED_RRF_ONLY: only if the fixed fair harness produces non-positive B-RRF deltas in all three seeds or a predeclared pooled CI upper <= 0, with all assets, budgets and audits valid; this stops only Exp99 RRF, never responsibility direction
decision.asset_or_harness_failure: hash mismatch, leakage, forbidden field, unequal budget, missing Gold/asset or evaluator error is ASSET_STOP/HARNESS_INVALID and cannot be counted as a method failure
decision.final_paper_gate: not evaluated here; preserve final >=10% relative improvement, task-group paired CI lower >0, and a real external Agent/framework/environment direction gate

execution.stage_a: protocol/data_seal/tests only; no runner, no scoring, no Gold reads
execution.stage_b: after main-thread review, implement one frozen runner and synthetic tests; first run only opaque boundary/hash audit and 731-train OOF
execution.stage_c: only after stage-1 continuation qualification and a newly frozen protocol may an independent external confirmation be considered; 180 confirmation and 163 official boundary remain unscored in this experiment
execution.execution_failure_escalation: same bounded execution step may be attempted three times; only an unexecutable portion may then be delegated to Sol, with no protocol relaxation
