scope.purpose: 只验证固定未见 Who&When Pro 页面是否具有可审计的多角色 Gold agent+step 评价对象，以及 Exp99/E88 25 维匿名结构表示和 pairwise_B 概率是否有可观测差异，资格通过后才进行一次固定零样本 RRF 外部确认。
scope.one_new_mechanism: 固定 k=60、recency 与 pairwise_B 匿名责任角色秩两路等权的无参数 RRF；不增加 API、token、候选或重试预算。
scope.stage_a_boundary: 本提交只冻结协议、数据封存、历史 ID 审计和预下载资格探针；禁止下载四个目标页面、读取目标页面 Gold、运行最终方法或计算外部指标。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 若固定目标页面在最多四页内没有达到预注册的 100 eligible rows、100 task groups、50 个结构可辨识 rows/50 个结构可辨识 groups 和 50 个非均匀 pairwise_B 概率 rows，STOP 只针对这四个固定未见页面与 Exp99/E88 25 维表示的外部评价资格；不得升级为 Who&When 资产全局 STOP、RRF 方向 NO-GO 或责任桥方向 NO-GO。

fixed_unseen_pages.raw_pages_write_location: runtime/raw_pages/ (ignored and never committed after Stage A)

seen_id_exclusion.rule: 在任何新页资格计算前，按精确字符串 id 去重并排除 Exp81、Exp83 及 Exp90 已经读取过的全部 ID；排除集合只用于防止重复评价，不进入方法输入。
seen_id_exclusion.audit_algorithm: 从已见页面逐行提取精确字符串 id，去重后按 UTF-8、排序值加换行计算 SHA-256；重新计算每个来源和四来源 union，记录 overlap 与 count。

gold_evaluation_object.unit: row for eligibility; task_group for independent count
gold_evaluation_object.mapping: trajectory must be a JSON list with explicit top-level agent/agent_id, role, integer round and integer position events; Gold must contain one agent and either step='round.position' or integer round+position; Gold must map uniquely to exactly one event.
exclude_without_guessing: single-agent flat action with no single Gold agent
round-only/debate Gold containing agents list but no single event coordinate
nested rounds without explicit event-level coordinates
gold_evaluation_object.task_group: sha1(normalized task)[:16], evaluator-only; framework, benchmark, id, role and Gold never enter method features

structural_identifiability.definition: 在 eligible rows 中，以匿名角色首次出现顺序分配 role_0、role_1...；对每行每个匿名角色生成 Exp99/E88 固定 25 维结构向量。至少 50 行且覆盖至少 50 个 task groups 的行必须存在两个及以上匿名角色的向量不完全相同；并且至少 50 行的 pairwise_B 角色概率满足 max(prob)-min(prob)>1e-12。

qualification.qualification_stop: 在按冻结顺序逐页读取后，若 eligible_rows>=100、task_groups>=100、nonidentical_role_vector_rows>=50、nonidentical_role_vector_groups>=50 且 nonuniform_pairwise_B_probability_rows>=50，则立即停止下载；若行/组门先达到但结构门未达到，继续只读取剩余固定目标页，直到全部门通过或四页用尽。

read_only_basis.read_only_rule: Exp90 adapter/schema and Exp99/E88 25-dimensional feature contract may be read for design and audit only; no Exp90/99 metrics or target-page Gold may be used to fit, tune or select Exp100.

training.method: Exp99 exact pairwise_B; no Who&When labels in fitting

rrf.tie_rule: exact probability ties receive average competition rank; exact fused-step-score ties receive average step rank; anonymous structural key is serialization-only and never splits a statistical tie

forbidden_method_inputs: lexical content, error words, raw string length
gold_isolation.external_gold_use: only eligibility mapping and final scoring; never training, thresholding, method selection or tuning

statistics_and_decision.unit: task_group for primary metric; row-level details retained
statistics_and_decision.global_comparator: select once from recency, fixed_first, fixed_midpoint, fixed_last and pairwise_local_bridge using the preregistered full-stage results; never choose per seed and never let RRF choose its own comparator
statistics_and_decision.EXTERNAL_RRF_FEASIBILITY_GO: 资格门通过；相对最强公平基线任务组 MRR 三个 seed 全正；每个 seed 的 paired bootstrap CI lower>0；deletion_recency exactly equals recency；shuffle 明显弱于 pairwise_B RRF；审计和预算全通过。该 GO 是第二个实验级可行性 GO，不是 final paper GO，10% 相对提升门仍保留。
statistics_and_decision.EXTERNAL_RRF_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO: 任何审计干净、同预算的真实正增益但 CI、10% 或其他最终门未通过；保留并迭代，不得 STOP。
statistics_and_decision.EXTERNAL_RRF_INCONCLUSIVE: 结果混合且无预注册的稳定负证据；只记录不确定，不触发方向停止。
statistics_and_decision.STOP_EXP100_FIXED_EXTERNAL_RRF_ONLY: 只有公平 Harness 下三 seed 全不正，或 pooled CI upper<=0，且全部资产、泄漏、成本和审计门通过时才允许；绝对停止对象仅为这次固定 external RRF，不停止 pairwise_B、Exp96/97/98 责任桥正向或 Who&When 方向。
statistics_and_decision.asset_or_harness_failure: ID overlap、revision/hash、Gold 映射、方法字段、预算或评估器错误属于 ASSET_STOP/HARNESS_INVALID，不计方法失败；修复后先复核 Base，再决定是否继续。

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

scope.absolute_stop_scope: 若固定 Exp96 OOF 上所有公平比较均无真实正向信号，只停止本次冻结的成本敏感选择门，不停止 pairwise_B、recency 或责任排序方向。

scope.oracle_rule: max(recency,pairwise_B) 只作 cached upper bound 审计，不进入 gate 特征、标签、训练、阈值、baseline 选择或 GO 判定。

data_and_split.source: Exp96 frozen 731 train records and 716 task groups; 3 seeds x 5 task-group outer folds; all arm predictions are strict OOF.
data_and_split.arm_prediction_definition: For each outer fold, fit original_A and pairwise_B on all outer-train groups and predict only outer-held records for the final evaluator. For gate training, use the other four original outer folds as four inner held folds; each inner arm fit uses the remaining three outer-train folds and predicts its inner-held fold. Reuse Exp96 frozen arm functions and E88 local/recency evaluator; no Exp97/98 Gold is read.
data_and_split.confirmation: Exp97/Exp98 historical result JSON only; no scoring or feature/threshold choice; future GO requires a new unseen confirmation set.
data_and_split.split_leakage_rule: For every outer fold, outer-held groups are excluded from every outer arm fit, every inner arm fit, every inner held fold, and gate fitting. Inner OOF covers outer-train groups exactly once; gate samples come only from those inner-held OOF predictions; outer-held arm predictions are used only by the final outer evaluator.

feature_semantics.role_count: number of anonymous roles in the trajectory
feature_semantics.pairwise_top1_top2_margin: largest pairwise_B role probability minus second largest; zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_normalized_entropy: -sum(p log p) / log(number of roles); zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_top_role_is_last_step_role: whether the final-turn role probability equals the maximum pairwise_B role probability, including ties; anonymous role names never break this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_step_is_recency_step: whether the final-turn numeric E2 fused score equals the global maximum, including ties; anonymous structure digest never breaks this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_second_numeric_gap: largest minus second-largest numeric E2 fused score, without tie-key contribution
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_minus_recency_numeric_ga: numeric E2 fused score at the top step minus the score at the final (recency) step

gate_input_contract.allowed_information: Only anonymous turns/structural E88 local score and pairwise_B predicted probabilities available at prediction time.
gate_input_contract.gold_use: Gold is used only after arm predictions to construct training labels and final evaluator metrics; it is never read by feature extraction or model fitting inputs.

gate_training.label: y=1 iff reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B) > reciprocal_rank(recency), y=0 iff smaller; exact ties are excluded
gate_training.sample_weight: abs(reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B)-reciprocal_rank(recency)), normalized over each gate training set to mean 1
gate_training.preprocessing: Feature means and population standard deviations are fit on outer-train gate samples only; outer-test is transformed with those values; zero scales use 1.0.
gate_training.outer_oof: For each outer fold, four inner OOF arm fits are made from the other three outer-train folds; gate fits only on the merged inner-held OOF predictions/labels. Clean outer-held arm predictions are then passed through that gate; no outer-held record enters an inner fit, inner held set, or gate fit.
gate_training.future_fit: After a real GO only, a future gate may fit all 731 Exp96 OOF gate records; this Stage B authorization does not run that future fit.

conditions.local: E88 frozen local structural rank, no responsibility bridge
conditions.selective_gate: pairwise_B iff fixed gate probability >= 0.5, otherwise recency
conditions.deletion_global_arm: the globally selected fair arm copied unchanged, with the gate removed
conditions.shuffled_gate_decision: deterministically shuffle selective gate decisions within each held fold, preserving the exact selection count and budget

statistics.bootstrap: 5000 task-group paired bootstrap resamples, percentile 95% CI

decision.go: SELECTIVE_GATE_FEASIBILITY_GO iff audit/deletion/shuffle/selection-rate gates pass, all 3 seeds have positive delta versus the one global strongest fair baseline, and every seed CI lower > 0; this is not final paper GO.
decision.positive_not_go: Any audit-clean positive delta in any seed or average is SELECTIVE_GATE_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO unless the GO gates all pass; do not STOP a positive signal because a CI crosses zero.
decision.stop: Only stable all-nonpositive clean fixed-OOF evidence may yield STOP_EXP101_FIXED_SELECTIVE_GATE_ONLY; it stops exactly this gate, not pairwise_B, recency, or the responsibility direction.
decision.harness: Asset, split, Gold-isolation, or implementation failure is HARNESS_INVALID/ASSET_STOP and does not count as a method failure.
decision.final_paper: The 10% final-paper gate remains separate and is not authorized by this Stage B freeze.

complete_config.title: 选择性回退：历史确认与官方边界压力复制

scope.purpose: 把 Exp101 已冻结的成本敏感选择门零调参部署到 Exp97 的 180 rows/168 groups 历史 confirmation 和 Exp98 的 163 rows/161 groups official test，检验两个历史边界上的机制压力复制。
scope.replication_boundary: Exp97/Exp98 的历史 arm 结果已知，因此本实验只能称为 gate 机制未见的压力复制，不能称为全新确认，也不能替代 final paper confirmation。
scope.external_gold_read_rule: external Gold may be read only by the final evaluator after all arm predictions and gate/shuffle decisions have complete coverage
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 任何 STOP 只停止固定 Exp101 deployment 在对应边界上的外推；两边界稳定全不正时也只停止该 deployment，不停止 pairwise_B、recency、Exp101 gate 或责任排序方向。
scope.history_rule: Exp97/Exp98 aggregate_results.json 和历史指标不进入 runner、数据选择、特征、阈值、baseline 或判定；README 可以说明边界背景，但不得把历史 arm 分数当作本实验结果。

train.fit_rule: same Exp96 loader and group6-confirm-v1 split
gold_allowed_for: Exp96 OOF arm labels and gate labels only

data_and_boundaries.fit_rule: For each seed, standard 5-fold group OOF on all 731 records creates arm predictions; one final gate is fitted on all OOF gate samples. Each external boundary then fits each arm once on all 731 records and predicts only that boundary.

gate_contract.feature_source: only anonymous structure and prediction-time pairwise_B probability; exactly Exp101 semantics including numeric tie handling
gate_contract.label: Exp96 OOF only: y=1 iff reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B)>reciprocal_rank(recency); exact ties excluded
gate_contract.weight: abs reciprocal-rank advantage normalized to mean 1 on all Exp96 OOF gate samples
gate_contract.standardization: fit on Exp96 OOF gate samples only; no external values
gate_contract.model: weighted logistic with intercept, L2=1.0, lr=0.05, epochs=200, threshold=0.5; no tuning

conditions.local: E88 frozen local structural step rank
conditions.original_A: Exp96 frozen original_A arm fitted on all 731 train records
conditions.pairwise_B: Exp96 frozen pairwise_B arm fitted on all 731 train records
conditions.selective_gate: pairwise_B iff fixed Exp101 gate probability >=0.5, otherwise recency
conditions.deletion_pairwise_B: deployment deletion: remove gate and always use pairwise_B
conditions.shuffled_gate_decision: deterministically shuffle gate decisions within each boundary/seed while preserving selection count

decision.boundary_go: STRESS_REPLICATION_GO for a boundary iff all three seeds are positive versus that boundary's one global strongest fair baseline, every seed CI lower >0, deletion_pairwise_B equals pairwise_B, shuffle is below selective_gate, and all audits pass.
decision.overall_go: STRESS_REPLICATION_GO iff both Exp97 and Exp98 boundary verdicts satisfy boundary_go; this is a stress-replication feasibility result, not a final paper confirmation.
decision.positive_not_go: Any audit-clean real positive on either boundary is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO unless all gates pass; do not STOP a positive signal because a CI crosses 0.
decision.inconclusive: Mixed or unstable boundary evidence without stable negative evidence is STRESS_REPLICATION_INCONCLUSIVE; do not direction-STOP.
decision.stop: Only stable all-nonpositive clean evidence may yield STOP_EXP102_FIXED_DEPLOYMENT_ONLY for the exact boundary/deployment; never direction-level NO-GO.
decision.asset_or_harness: ASSET_STOP or HARNESS_INVALID; does not count as method failure.
decision.final_paper: Final >=10% relative, CI lower >0, and genuinely new external confirmation remain separate and are not tested here.

last_invalid_attempt.reason: Exp98 boundary loader did not expose official_ids; runner attempted to read a non-contract field

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

scope.oracle_rule: max(recency,pairwise_B) 只作 cached upper bound 审计，不进入 gate 特征、标签、训练、阈值、baseline 选择或 GO 判定。

data_and_split.source: Exp96 frozen 731 train records and 716 task groups; 3 seeds x 5 task-group outer folds; all arm predictions are strict OOF.
data_and_split.arm_prediction_definition: For each outer fold, fit original_A and pairwise_B on all outer-train groups and predict only outer-held records for the final evaluator. For gate training, use the other four original outer folds as four inner held folds; each inner arm fit uses the remaining three outer-train folds and predicts its inner-held fold. Reuse Exp96 frozen arm functions and E88 local/recency evaluator; no Exp97/98 Gold is read.
data_and_split.confirmation: Exp97/Exp98 historical result JSON only; no scoring or feature/threshold choice; future GO requires a new unseen confirmation set.
data_and_split.split_leakage_rule: For every outer fold, outer-held groups are excluded from every outer arm fit, every inner arm fit, every inner held fold, and gate fitting. Inner OOF covers outer-train groups exactly once; gate samples come only from those inner-held OOF predictions; outer-held arm predictions are used only by the final outer evaluator.

feature_semantics.role_count: number of anonymous roles in the trajectory
feature_semantics.pairwise_top1_top2_margin: largest pairwise_B role probability minus second largest; zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_normalized_entropy: -sum(p log p) / log(number of roles); zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_top_role_is_last_step_role: whether the final-turn role probability equals the maximum pairwise_B role probability, including ties; anonymous role names never break this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_step_is_recency_step: whether the final-turn numeric E2 fused score equals the global maximum, including ties; anonymous structure digest never breaks this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_second_numeric_gap: largest minus second-largest numeric E2 fused score, without tie-key contribution
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_minus_recency_numeric_ga: numeric E2 fused score at the top step minus the score at the final (recency) step

gate_input_contract.allowed_information: Only anonymous turns/structural E88 local score and pairwise_B predicted probabilities available at prediction time.
gate_input_contract.gold_use: Gold is used only after arm predictions to construct training labels and final evaluator metrics; it is never read by feature extraction or model fitting inputs.

gate_training.label: y=1 iff reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B) > reciprocal_rank(recency), y=0 iff smaller; exact ties are excluded
gate_training.sample_weight: abs(reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B)-reciprocal_rank(recency)), normalized over each gate training set to mean 1
gate_training.preprocessing: Feature means and population standard deviations are fit on outer-train gate samples only; outer-test is transformed with those values; zero scales use 1.0.
gate_training.outer_oof: For each outer fold, four inner OOF arm fits are made from the other three outer-train folds; gate fits only on the merged inner-held OOF predictions/labels. Clean outer-held arm predictions are then passed through that gate; no outer-held record enters an inner fit, inner held set, or gate fit.
gate_training.future_fit: After a real GO only, a future gate may fit all 731 Exp96 OOF gate records; this Stage B authorization does not run that future fit.

conditions.local: E88 frozen local structural rank, no responsibility bridge
conditions.selective_gate: pairwise_B iff fixed gate probability >= 0.5, otherwise recency
conditions.robust_selective_gate: Exp101 selective_gate decision AND pairwise probability >= 0.65 AND top1-top2 margin >= 0.15; otherwise recency
conditions.deletion_global_arm: the globally selected fair arm copied unchanged, with the gate removed
conditions.shuffled_gate_decision: deterministically shuffle robust selective gate decisions within each held fold, preserving the exact selection count and budget

upgrade.rationale: Suppress pairwise choices that are near a probability or top-two ambiguity boundary; all inputs are prediction-time-visible and fit-free.

statistics.bootstrap: 5000 task-group paired bootstrap resamples, percentile 95% CI

decision.go: ROBUST_SELECTIVE_GATE_FEASIBILITY_GO iff audit/deletion/shuffle/selection-rate gates pass, all 3 seeds have positive delta for robust_selective_gate versus the one global strongest fair baseline, and every seed CI lower > 0; this is not final paper GO.
decision.positive_not_go: Any audit-clean positive delta in any seed or average is SELECTIVE_GATE_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO unless the GO gates all pass; do not STOP a positive signal because a CI crosses zero.
decision.stop: Only stable all-nonpositive clean fixed-OOF evidence may yield STOP_EXP104_ROBUST_GUARD_ONLY; it stops exactly this guard, not Exp101 selective_gate, pairwise_B, recency, or the responsibility direction.
decision.harness: Asset, split, Gold-isolation, or implementation failure is HARNESS_INVALID/ASSET_STOP and does not count as a method failure.
decision.final_paper: The 10% final-paper gate remains separate and is not authorized by this Stage B freeze.

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

scope.purpose: 以固定 SOFT_ALPHA=0.5 连续凸组合，同一记录内分别归一化 pairwise_B 数值步骤分数与完全 Gold-free 的 recency 步骤分数；不搜阈值、不调权重、不增加 API/token/candidate。
scope.failure_mechanism: Exp99 的无参数秩融合存在三 seed 同向小正信号；Exp104 固定稳健门坍缩为零选择。本实验将离散门替换为无阈值连续融合，检验责任与时序信号的尺度对齐。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 稳定全非正只停止本次固定 alpha=0.5、逐记录 min-max 连续融合，不停止 Exp101 硬门、pairwise_B、recency 或责任排序方向。
scope.historical_replication_boundary: Exp97/Exp98 的历史 arm 结果只用于透明 stress/oracle 上界审计，不是新的未见确认；即使 gate 在 Exp96 OOF 上满足 GO，仍必须在新的未见确认集验证。
scope.oracle_rule: 缓存 Oracle 只作透明历史审计，不进入 soft scores、硬门、baseline 或 GO 判定。

data_and_split.source: Exp96 frozen 731 train records and 716 task groups; 3 seeds x 5 task-group outer folds. All original_A/pairwise_B predictions are strict nested OOF-compatible; Exp101 hard gate uses inner labels.
data_and_split.arm_prediction_definition: Each outer fold fits original_A and pairwise_B only on outer-train and predicts outer-held. Four inner OOF fits cover outer-train exactly once for the retained Exp101 hard-gate comparator. Soft fusion itself has no fitted parameter and uses only each outer-held record plus its outer-OOF pairwise_B predictions.
data_and_split.confirmation: Exp97/Exp98 historical result JSON only; no scoring or feature/threshold choice; future GO requires a new unseen confirmation set.
data_and_split.split_leakage_rule: For every outer fold, outer-held groups are excluded from every outer arm fit, every inner arm fit, every inner held fold, and gate fitting. Inner OOF covers outer-train groups exactly once; gate samples come only from those inner-held OOF predictions; outer-held arm predictions are used only by the final outer evaluator.

feature_semantics.role_count: number of anonymous roles in the trajectory
feature_semantics.pairwise_top1_top2_margin: largest pairwise_B role probability minus second largest; zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_normalized_entropy: -sum(p log p) / log(number of roles); zero for one role
feature_semantics.pairwise_top_role_is_last_step_role: whether the final-turn role probability equals the maximum pairwise_B role probability, including ties; anonymous role names never break this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_step_is_recency_step: whether the final-turn numeric E2 fused score equals the global maximum, including ties; anonymous structure digest never breaks this feature tie
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_second_numeric_gap: largest minus second-largest numeric E2 fused score, without tie-key contribution
feature_semantics.pairwise_e2_top_minus_recency_numeric_ga: numeric E2 fused score at the top step minus the score at the final (recency) step

gate_input_contract.allowed_information: Only anonymous turns/structural E88 local score and pairwise_B predicted probabilities available at prediction time.
gate_input_contract.gold_use: Gold is used only after arm predictions to construct training labels and final evaluator metrics; it is never read by feature extraction or model fitting inputs.

gate_training.label: y=1 iff reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B) > reciprocal_rank(recency), y=0 iff smaller; exact ties are excluded
gate_training.sample_weight: abs(reciprocal_rank(pairwise_B)-reciprocal_rank(recency)), normalized over each gate training set to mean 1
gate_training.preprocessing: Feature means and population standard deviations are fit on outer-train gate samples only; outer-test is transformed with those values; zero scales use 1.0.
gate_training.outer_oof: For each outer fold, four inner OOF arm fits are made from the other three outer-train folds; gate fits only on the merged inner-held OOF predictions/labels. Clean outer-held arm predictions are then passed through that gate; no outer-held record enters an inner fit, inner held set, or gate fit.
gate_training.future_fit: After a real GO only, a future gate may fit all 731 Exp96 OOF gate records; this Stage B authorization does not run that future fit.

conditions.exp101_hard_gate: Frozen Exp101 fixed-threshold hard gate retained as compatibility comparator, not eligible for global fair-baseline selection
conditions.soft_fusion: Fixed alpha=0.5 convex blend of same-record normalized pairwise_B numeric step scores and Gold-free recency step scores
conditions.deletion_global_arm: One globally strongest fair baseline copied unchanged
conditions.shuffled_soft_weights: Within each record deterministically shuffle the normalized pairwise component across steps; preserve its exact multiset and fixed alpha

statistics.bootstrap: 5000 task-group paired bootstrap resamples, percentile 95% CI

decision.go: SOFT_FUSION_FEASIBILITY_GO iff all audits and deletion/shuffle gates pass, all 3 seed deltas versus the single global strongest fair baseline are positive, and each paired bootstrap CI lower bound is >0.
decision.positive_not_go: Any audit-clean positive delta in any seed is SOFT_FUSION_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO when not all GO gates pass; a CI crossing zero is not a STOP.
decision.stop: Only stable all-nonpositive clean evidence yields STOP_EXP105_FIXED_SOFT_FUSION_ONLY; scope is this exact fusion only and direction_no_go remains false.
decision.harness: Asset/hash/split/Gold-isolation/implementation failure is HARNESS_INVALID and is not method failure.
decision.final_paper: Final-paper and two-chapter GO are separate; this experiment can supply one RQ feasibility GO only.

soft_fusion_contract.pairwise_component: For each record, E88 local step score + Exp96 BRIDGE_WEIGHT * outer-OOF pairwise_B role probability, then record-local min-max normalization to [0,1]; constant vector maps to neutral 0.5.
soft_fusion_contract.recency_component: For n>1 turns, step index/(n-1), then record-local min-max normalization to [0,1]; one-turn record maps to neutral 0.5. Reads neither mistake_step nor mistake_agent.
soft_fusion_contract.ranking: Higher fused numeric score ranks first; exact numeric ties within 1e-12 receive average rank; no anonymous digest breaks a numeric tie.
soft_fusion_contract.gold_use: Gold mistake_step is read only by final rank evaluator; mistake_agent is never read by soft scoring. Gold may label only inner OOF records for the retained Exp101 hard-gate comparator.

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

complete_config.title: 责任排序 Top-1 提升级联

scope.purpose: 利用 Exp105 R@1 正信号只提升一个候选，其余候选完全保留 pairwise_B 数值秩，修复连续融合的秩深度错配。
scope.absolute_stop_scope: 稳定全非正只停止本次固定 Top-1 提升+原始 pairwise_B 尾部实现；direction_no_go=false。

data_and_split.split_leakage_rule: Each outer-held task group is excluded from its outer arm fit and all four inner fits/held folds; inner OOF covers outer-train exactly once.

top1_cascade_contract.soft_source: Exp105 fixed alpha=0.5 per-record normalized soft_fusion scores; no alpha or threshold search.
top1_cascade_contract.promotion: Choose exactly one maximum soft-score candidate and rank it first.
top1_cascade_contract.soft_tie_rule: Order maximum-score candidates by Exp88 anonymous role+shape digest, then use SHA-256(fixed salt + full anonymous positional trajectory) modulo tie count; final local position only enumerates structurally identical candidates. No original identifier or Gold.
top1_cascade_contract.tail: Remove the promoted candidate; rank every remaining step by frozen pairwise_B numeric E2 score descending. Numeric ties within 1e-12 receive average rank.
top1_cascade_contract.gold_use: mistake_step is read only by final rank evaluator. Promotion, soft scores, pairwise scores and tie selection read no mistake_agent or mistake_step.

statistics.global_fair_baseline: Select once after averaging each fair baseline across all three seeds.

decision.go: TOP1_CASCADE_FEASIBILITY_GO iff all audits, deletion and shuffle gates pass; every seed delta vs one global fair baseline is positive; every seed CI lower bound is >0.
decision.positive_not_go: Any audit-clean positive seed delta without all GO gates yields TOP1_CASCADE_POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO; CI crossing zero is not STOP.
decision.stop: Only stable all-nonpositive clean evidence yields STOP_EXP106_FIXED_TOP1_CASCADE_ONLY; direction_no_go remains false.
decision.harness: Any asset/hash/split/Gold-isolation/implementation failure is HARNESS_INVALID, not method failure.

train.router_training: per seed, strict group OOF predictions create all 731 continuous utility targets and Gold-free 9-feature rows; fit one full-train ExtraTrees router

router.decision: predicted utility > 0 selects Exp106; otherwise recency
router.external_gold: not available to arm fit, features, model, threshold, or decisions; attach only after complete coverage

conditions.shuffle: preserve structured-arm selection count on each boundary and seed

statistics.comparator_selection: once per boundary by three-seed average MRR

decision.boundary_go: target mean relative gain vs strongest fair >=10%; every seed fair delta positive and every seed CI lower >0; every seed component delta positive and pooled component CI lower >0; deletion, shuffle, isolation and budget audits pass
decision.overall_go: TWO_CHAPTER_OPENING_EXTERNAL_GO iff at least one boundary GO and every other boundary has three-seed mean absolute delta vs its strongest fair baseline >=0
decision.positive: any clean positive signal without every GO gate is POSITIVE_NOT_YET_GO
decision.stop: only both boundaries stably all-nonpositive vs fair may stop this exact external transfer; direction_no_go=false

data_and_split.outer_fold_assignment: sorted task_group values; random.Random(seed).shuffle; fold i receives shuffled_groups[i::5]
data_and_split.nested_inner_assignment: the other four original outer folds; for each inner held fold, fit only on the other three folds of outer-train
data_and_split.outer_held_scope: one outer fold, never in any fit, inner-held OOF, formula choice, baseline choice, or audit-derived method decision
data_and_split.inner_scope_prediction: scope model fit on inner-fit and predicts inner-held; inner-held scope posterior is the only scope feature used to train the outer locator
data_and_split.outer_scope_prediction: scope model fit on all outer-train and predicts outer-held
data_and_split.outer_locator_fit: step locator fit on all outer-train records using their strict inner-OOF scope features; it predicts only outer-held using the final outer scope posterior
data_and_split.record_coverage: every train record is outer-held exactly once per seed; every outer-train record is inner-held exactly once within its outer fold

input_contract.base_features: Exp88 anonymous structural features and relative position only
input_contract.role_anonymization: first appearance in each trajectory -> role_0, role_1, ...; raw role never enters a feature
allowed: relative phase and relative step position
scope posterior q and posterior-derived role/phase marginals
forbidden: raw role identity or tool name
absolute trajectory length or absolute activity count
mistake_agent or mistake_step in scope/locator inputs
input_contract.gold_use: mistake_agent and mistake_step are used only for inner/outer-train labels and the final evaluator; never for outer-held scope, locator features, scores, or ranking
input_contract.feature_purity_audit: all feature names and constructors must prove absence of forbidden fields; task_group may occur only in split identity and grouped statistics

scope_model_contract.name: failure_scope_posterior
scope_model_contract.candidate_definition: actual cells (anonymous_role, phase) present in the trajectory
scope_model_contract.phase: phase(i,n)=min(2,floor(3*i/n)) for zero-based step i and n>0; no phase is inferred for an empty trajectory
scope_model_contract.gold_scope: the actual (anonymous_role, phase) cell containing gold mistake_step; only labels fit on inner/outer-train

cell_feature_definition.role_aggregation: Exp88 anonymous per-role structural feature vector, normalized within trajectory as in Exp96
cell_feature_definition.cell_structure_mean: mean of Exp88 anonymous single-step structural descriptor values over steps in that cell; no denominator or absolute count
cell_feature_definition.phase_encoding: fixed phase one-hot for 0,1,2 plus relative phase value phase/2
cell_feature_definition.cell_role_encoding: anonymous role one-hot in first-appearance order; no raw identity

fit.objective: within-trajectory gold-cell versus every non-gold-cell pairwise logistic; append both (gold-negative,1) and (negative-gold,0)
fit.bias: fit but omitted from within-trajectory utility differences

posterior.normalization: stable softmax over actual candidate cells only; subtract max utility before exp
posterior.role_marginal: sum q over steps of each anonymous role
posterior.phase_marginal: sum q over steps of each phase
posterior.empty_trajectory: no candidates, empty q and empty ranking; the frozen AFTraj train partition is expected to contain none

degeneracy.uniform_scope_definition: q is uniform over every step within numerical tolerance 1e-12
degeneracy.single_cell_definition: the trajectory has exactly one actual (role,phase) cell
degeneracy.mechanism_invalid: if every non-single-cell evaluated trajectory has uniform q, or every evaluated trajectory has one actual cell, mark scope mechanism invalid rather than changing the gate

locator_contract.name: scope_conditioned_localization
locator_contract.training_input: all outer-train records paired with strict inner-OOF scope features; no in-sample scope posterior
locator_contract.held_input: outer-held records paired only with final outer scope model predictions

features.role_marginal: role marginal of the step's anonymous role
features.phase_marginal: phase marginal of the step's phase
features.anonymous_single_step_structure: Exp88 descriptor values only through q-gated interactions
features.interaction_rule: every locator feature is q- or affinity-derived; no free structure/role/phase/position term
features.scope_deletion_invariant: when q is all zero, all derived features and every locator utility equal the same constant 0

fit.objective: gold step versus every non-gold step pairwise logistic; append both ordered directions
fit.bias: fit but omitted from within-trajectory utility differences

locator_contract.utility: w dot locator_feature_vector; no free intercept in ranking
locator_contract.gold_isolation: gold step is used only to construct outer-train/inner-held pair labels and final evaluator rank

score_and_ranking_contract.pairwise_numeric_score: frozen Exp96/Exp106 E2 numeric score: Exp88 local step score + 3.0 * outer-OOF pairwise_B anonymous-role posterior
score_and_ranking_contract.component_normalization: record-local min-max to [0,1]; a constant vector maps every value to 0.5
score_and_ranking_contract.ranking: higher numeric B score first; all steps remain in the candidate set; numeric ties within 1e-12 receive average rank
score_and_ranking_contract.global_coverage: every non-empty outer-held trajectory has a rank for every step; target coverage must be exactly 100%
score_and_ranking_contract.deletion: set q, role/phase marginals, affinity and all q-gated locator features to zero; locator utility is constant and B rank must equal pairwise_B rank record-by-record
score_and_ranking_contract.shuffle: deterministically permute per-step q within each held trajectory using only seed plus anonymous task-group split identity; preserve q mass multiset and derive all marginals/affinity after permutation; rotate when possible if unchanged
score_and_ranking_contract.random_scope: find the predicted MAP cell with anonymous deterministic tie key, preserve its step count k, choose k steps deterministically uniformly using seed plus anonymous task-group split identity, assign q=1/k to selected steps and 0 otherwise; never use Gold
score_and_ranking_contract.oracle_scope: evaluator-only replacement q=uniform on Gold joint (anonymous_role,phase) cell; never used in training, baseline choice, formula choice or Gate

conditions.A_exp106_top1_cascade: frozen Exp106 Top-1 cascade: invoke its promotion choice and pairwise_B tail exactly, no Gold; cache agreement is an audit
conditions.B_scope_first: the complete scope posterior + scope-conditioned locator + global full ranking defined above
conditions.A_plus_B: Exp106 unique promoted step fixed rank 1; after removing it, every remaining step is ranked by B numeric score descending with average numeric ties; no learned fusion, threshold or weight
conditions.B_deletion: B with all scope-derived features zero; must rank exactly as pairwise_B
conditions.B_shuffle: B using shuffled per-step q and re-derived scope features
conditions.random_scope: B using deterministic uniform scope with predicted MAP cell size k
conditions.oracle_scope: B evaluator-only Gold joint-cell upper bound

statistics.seed_ci: within each seed, paired task-group mean reciprocal-rank differences
statistics.pooled_ci: first average per-task-group differences across the three seeds, then bootstrap the common task-group map with 5000 resamples
statistics.global_fair_baseline: select once as the maximum three-seed average task-group MRR among local/original_A/pairwise_B/recency; never switch by seed or condition
statistics.bootstrap_seed_rule: fixed deterministic seed derived from experiment seed and comparison index; no post-run change

a_exact_reproduction.implementation: A condition must call frozen Exp106 choose_promoted_top and cascade rank functions with identical pairwise probabilities

gate.module_candidate: B relative to the single strongest fair baseline > 0.08, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, and pooled task-group paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
gate.formal_module_feasible: B relative to the same baseline >= 0.10, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, and pooled CI lower bound > 0
gate.chapter_metric_go_candidate: A+B relative to the same strongest fair baseline >= 0.15, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0, A+B relative to A has pooled CI lower bound > 0, B-deletion is exactly pairwise_B, B-shuffle and random-scope have lower three-seed average MRR than B, Oracle is not below B, and all nested/Gold/coverage audits pass
gate.complementary_failure_wording: if A+B passes the main 15% gate but A+B versus A pooled CI lower bound is not >0, report 主15%已过但B对A互补证据不足 and do not announce a chapter candidate
gate.positive_signal: retain every audit-clean non-error positive result with raw scores, deltas, CI and subgroups even below 8%
gate.oracle: Oracle never enters a baseline, method fit, formula choice or Gate
gate.harness_invalid: asset/split/Gold-isolation/coverage/implementation failures are HARNESS_INVALID, not method failure

stopping.continue: B > 0 but below 8% is retained and evaluated in A+B; no threshold or formula changes
stopping.next: if Exp111 is insufficient for the chapter gate, continue with frozen Exp112 replacement module rather than retuning Exp111
stopping.stop: only stable all-nonpositive B and A+B with valid audits may stop this fixed implementation; any other positive signal is retained
stopping.scope_constant: scope posterior constant or full-trajectory degenerate is mechanism invalid, not a statistical excuse to change the Gate

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

complete_config.title: Exp112 digest-tie harness corrected formal replay

scope.research_question: 仅纠正 Exp112 唯一 Harness digest payload 缺陷并完整重放原冻结正式实验，不引入新模块。
scope.module_identity: Exp112 RQ1 B2 temporal/agent-interaction/tool-state dependency global full ranking; unchanged
scope.correction_statement: 原 Exp112 helper _anonymous_digest 的 payload 与 Exp88 byte-for-byte tie key 不一致；Exp112C 只绑定已修复的 E88._tie_digest 调用及新的输出目录，然后重新执行全部三 seed、五 outer、strict inner OOF、所有条件与 Gate。

original_exp112_result.preservation: 永久保留；仅作触发 correction 和 provenance，不读取其 outer-held metrics，不重写该文件。

scope.superseded_policy: 上述停止支线的协议、代码、草稿和任何结果均不得读取、导入、合并或作为第二次实验、正提升或章节 GO 证据。

source_binding.fixed_science_runner: 实验/实验112_RQ1时序交互依赖完整排序/runner.py
source_binding.digest_semantics: 直接调用 Exp88 E88._tie_digest；不得复制、改写或重新序列化 digest payload。
source_binding.wrapper_policy: Exp112C runner 只读 import 上述 fixed runner，复用 run_seed、aggregate、audit_bound_assets 及 frozen helpers；wrapper 自己拥有 output guard、preflight、main、metadata。
source_binding.equivalence_rule: 除 source binding 的 digest correction 和新 output/provenance path 外，data、seed、fold、graph、optimizer、stack、score、controls、bootstrap、fair-baseline 和 Gate 逐项等于 a13e5aa protocol。

data_and_split.outer_fold_assignment: sorted task_group values; random.Random(seed).shuffle; fold i receives shuffled_groups[i::5]
data_and_split.nested_inner_assignment: the other four original outer folds; each inner-held fold is predicted by a fit on the other three folds of outer-train
data_and_split.outer_held_scope: one outer fold; never enters any fit, inner-held OOF, formula choice, fair-baseline choice, control construction, or Gate
data_and_split.inner_oof_scope: for every outer-train record, A and B2 step scores are generated exactly once from an inner-held prediction; stacker fits only these inner-held OOF scores and Gold pair labels
data_and_split.outer_prediction_coverage: every development record is outer-held exactly once per seed

representation_and_graph.input_contract: Exp112 original protocol unchanged: Exp88 anonymous 17 structural descriptors + frozen local score + normalized relative position + fixed three-phase one-hot + anonymous first-appearance role index; no Gold/lexical/task/domain/absolute activity/Exp111 or forbidden asset feature.
representation_and_graph.edge_semantics: same Exp112 protocol: directed prev/next adjacent and nearest same anonymous role/full-shape/non-empty-action neighbors; anonymous structural labels only.
graph_audits: random dependency node and edge-count preservation

optimizer_and_score.pairwise_numeric_score: frozen Exp106/Exp88 pairwise_B numeric E2 score
optimizer_and_score.b2_deletion_contract: graph utility all zero before min-max; rank equals true Exp106/Exp88 pairwise_B digest-tie rank record-by-record
optimizer_and_score.constant_component: constant vector maps every value to 0.5

stacking.fit_optimizer: same fixed pairwise logistic: epochs 200, lr 0.05, l2 0.001, pos_weight 1.0
stacking.constant_fallback: if stack utility is constant, use B2 score only

controls.delete_A: zero A, cross terms, is_A_promoted and abs difference; retain B2 and is_B2_numeric_top
controls.delete_B2: zero B2, cross terms, is_B2_numeric_top and abs difference; retain A and is_A_promoted
controls.shuffle_B2: deterministically permute held-trajectory B2 values preserving multiset and recompute all seven features

conditions.global_fair_baseline: average each fair baseline across all three seeds, then select one maximum; do not choose per seed and do not use corrected result to select a formula

statistics_and_gate.pooled_bootstrap: average each task-group difference across three seeds, then bootstrap common task-group map with 5000 resamples

gate.module_candidate: B2 relative to one strongest fair baseline > 0.08, all seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0
gate.formal_module_feasible: B2 relative to same baseline >= 0.10, all seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0
gate.chapter_metric_go_candidate: A+B relative to same baseline >= 0.15, all seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0; all Exp112 deletion/shuffle/random controls and audits pass
gate.no_extra_ci_gate: A+B versus A/B2 CIs are reported but are not additional main-gate requirements
gate.oracle: Oracle_step never enters training, baseline selection or Gate
gate.harness_invalid: path/split/Gold-isolation/coverage/implementation failures are HARNESS_INVALID, not method failure

method_isolation.allowed_audits: only bound code path/function source, loader/split/scientific audits and final formal-result SHA

stopping.insufficient: if corrected B2 or A+B is below frozen gate, stop only this fixed implementation and preserve every audit-clean real positive; continue handoff to Exp113 and Exp114

entries.retention: 保留正式结果、协议、原始预测/费用/候选/测试证据；不按本行摘要自动删除。
entries.exclusion_and_next_use: 不作为外部完整系统优势；仅在本行限定范围内使用。与后续当前主线的关系见独立综述。
entries.evidence_limit: 本轮只读核对。机器facts含历史与纠正多版本，不能按最后文件名推定有效性；正文明确选用结果。缺失原始资产不填0。

compatibility.exp96: frozen development loader, split and Gold-pair construction
compatibility.exp88: anonymous structural descriptors, frozen E88 local score and digest tie
compatibility.exp106: frozen pairwise_B numeric score and exact A promotion/cascade calls

bound_read_only_assets.asset_hash_check: not repeated; only required path/loader/split/Gold/coverage/control audits are run

data_and_split.outer_fold_assignment: sorted task_group values; random.Random(seed).shuffle; fold i receives shuffled_groups[i::5]
data_and_split.nested_inner_assignment: the other four original outer folds; each inner-held fold is predicted by a fit on the other three folds of outer-train
data_and_split.outer_held_scope: one outer fold; never enters any fit, inner-held OOF, formula choice, fair-baseline choice, control construction, or Gate
data_and_split.inner_oof_scope: for every outer-train record, A and B2 step scores are generated exactly once from an inner-held prediction; stacker fits only these inner-held OOF scores and Gold pair labels
data_and_split.outer_prediction_coverage: every development record is outer-held exactly once per seed

input_contract.representation_source: Exp88 anonymous structural descriptors plus frozen E88 local structural score
allowed: 17 Exp88 anonymous per-step structural descriptor numerics
forbidden: Gold fields except outer-train pair-label construction and final evaluator
input_contract.role_anonymization: first appearance in each trajectory maps roles to anonymous role_0, role_1, ...; role_index is width-independent normalized position only
input_contract.role_count: used only as the denominator max(1, role_count-1) for normalized role_index; never emitted separately
input_contract.gold_use: mistake_agent/mistake_step are used only to create outer-train Gold-vs-non-Gold pair labels and to evaluate held ranks; no held Gold enters features or scores
input_contract.task_group_use: split identity, deterministic control seed and grouped statistics only

representation_contract.phase: phase(i,n)=min(2,floor(3*i/n)) for zero-based i and n>0; no phase is defined for empty trajectories
representation_contract.role_index: anonymous first-appearance ordinal/max(1, role_count-1); width-independent and no role vocabulary

channels.name: same_role
channels.edges: nearest previous and nearest next step with the same anonymous role

channels.name: same_full_shape_signature
channels.edges: nearest previous and nearest next step with the same anonymous full shape signature

channels.name: same_nonempty_action_shape
channels.edges: nearest previous and nearest next step with the same non-empty anonymous action shape

dependency_graph_contract.directionality: each prev/next edge is a directed neighbor relation; reciprocal edges are emitted when both directions exist
dependency_graph_contract.neighbor_absence: a missing neighbor contributes an all-zero mean and zero presence bit
dependency_graph_contract.edge_input: only anonymous structural labels; never keys, scalar values, tool names or lexical content

message_passing.per_round: for every channel independently, take the mean of neighbor representations from the previous round and retain the node self representation
message_passing.final_feature: h0 + round1 mean for each channel + round2 mean for each channel + per-channel normalized relative-gap mean + per-channel presence bit
message_passing.relative_gap: gap/max(1,n-1), averaged over the channel's present neighbors; zero when absent
message_passing.graph_feature_dimension: fixed by the frozen h0 and four channels; no data-dependent truncation

graph_audits: graph utility variance and constant rate
random-dependency node count and every channel edge count preserved

b2_locator_contract.name: temporal_agent_interaction_tool_state_dependency_global_ranking
b2_locator_contract.training: for each outer-train trajectory, pair its Gold step against every non-Gold step; append positive Gold-minus-negative and reverse negative-minus-Gold pairs

fit.objective: fixed pairwise logistic on graph features
fit.bias: fit if source optimizer returns one, but omit it from within-trajectory utility differences

b2_locator_contract.outer_held: graph utility is predicted only from outer-train fit; no outer-held Gold, labels or metric is used
b2_locator_contract.utility: dot(fitted weights, final graph feature); no free intercept in ranking

score_and_ranking_contract.pairwise_numeric_score: frozen Exp106/Exp88 pairwise_B numeric E2 score; no Exp96/97/98 parameter change
score_and_ranking_contract.graph_numeric_score: record-local min-max graph utility; a constant vector maps every value to 0.5
score_and_ranking_contract.b2_numeric_score: 0.5*minmax(frozen pairwise_B numeric E2 score)+0.5*minmax(graph utility); alpha fixed at 0.5
score_and_ranking_contract.tie_rule: only when numeric score and anonymous digest both match, assign average rank; digest tie is used identically by B2-deletion and true pairwise_B baseline
score_and_ranking_contract.b2_deletion: graph utility is all zero before min-max; B2-deletion rank must equal true Exp106/Exp88 pairwise_B digest-tie rank record-by-record
score_and_ranking_contract.b2_shuffle: deterministic held-trajectory permutation of graph utility using seed+task_group split identity; preserve the utility multiset and force a changed assignment whenever values vary
score_and_ranking_contract.random_dependency: deterministically permute anonymous node labels keyed by seed+task_group and remap all dependency channels; preserve node count and each channel edge count; recompute two-round aggregation and graph utility; never use Gold
score_and_ranking_contract.constant_component: constant pairwise or graph component maps to 0.5; no result-dependent alternate formula

a_condition_contract.implementation: call frozen Exp106 promotion and cascade-rank functions exactly; no reimplementation with altered tie semantics
a_condition_contract.pairwise_probability_source: frozen outer-held Exp106 pairwise_B probability output

stacking_contract.scope: A+B strict learned OOF stacking; no outer-held score or Gold enters fit
stacking_contract.inner_oof: inside each outer-train, each of the other four original outer folds is held once; fit pairwise_B and B2 separately on the remaining three, predict the inner-held records, and generate exactly one A and B2 step score per outer-train record
stacking_contract.outer_fit: fit pairwise_B and B2 on all outer-train records, predict only outer-held; stacker is never fit on outer-held
stacking_contract.a_step_score: promoted step=2.0; every other step=frozen pairwise numeric score record-local min-max normalized to [0,1]; no Gold

stack_fit.labels: outer-train inner-held Gold-vs-non-Gold step pairs only

stacking_contract.outer_held_ranking: stack utility with the same (-utility, anonymous role+shape digest) key and full step coverage
stacking_contract.constant_fallback: if stack utility is constant, use B2 score only; this branch is pre-frozen and its rate is reported

controls.delete_A: zero A, A-minus-B2, A-times-B2, is_A_promoted and abs_A_minus_B2; retain B2 and is_B2_numeric_top
controls.delete_B2: zero B2, A-minus-B2, A-times-B2, is_B2_numeric_top and abs_A_minus_B2; retain A and is_A_promoted
controls.shuffle_B2: deterministically permute held-trajectory B2 scores preserving their multiset, recompute all seven stack features and rank

conditions.global_fair_baseline: average each fair baseline across all three seeds, then select the single maximum; do not choose per seed and do not hard-code the expected winner
conditions.oracle: Oracle_step is an evaluator upper bound only; never a fit input, baseline, formula choice or Gate input

statistics.seed_bootstrap: bootstrap per seed on task-group paired differences
statistics.pooled_bootstrap: first average each task-group difference across three seeds, then bootstrap the common task-group map with 5000 resamples

gold_isolation: Gold only in outer-train pair labels and final evaluator
no held Gold in feature/score/stack fit
nested: inner OOF A/B2 coverage exactly once
stack fit uses inner OOF only
controls: B2 deletion exact pairwise_B digest-tie rank
audits.coverage: every condition ranks every step of every outer-held non-empty trajectory exactly once
audits.hash_policy: do not repeat broad asset/hash checks; record formal result SHA only after successful write

gate.module_candidate: B2 relative to the single strongest fair baseline > 0.08, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled task-group paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
gate.formal_module_feasible: B2 relative to the same baseline >= 0.10, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0
gate.chapter_metric_go_candidate: A+B relative to the same baseline >= 0.15, all three seed absolute deltas > 0, pooled CI lower bound > 0; A+B-delete-A, A+B-delete-B2 and A+B-shuffle-B2 each have lower three-seed average MRR than full A+B; B2-deletion is exact true pairwise_B; B2-shuffle and random-dependency are lower than B2; all split/Gold/coverage/A-cache/nested/graph audits pass
gate.no_extra_ci_gate: A+B versus A and A+B versus B2 pooled CIs are reported but are not additional main-gate requirements
gate.oracle: Oracle_step never enters training, baseline selection or Gate
gate.positive_signal: retain every audit-clean non-error positive result with raw scores, deltas, CI and subgroups even below 8%
gate.harness_invalid: asset/path/split/Gold-isolation/coverage/implementation failures are HARNESS_INVALID, not method failure

stopping.insufficient: if B2 or A+B is below its frozen gate, stop only this implementation and preserve every real positive signal; do not rewrite the direction as NO-GO
stopping.next: continue the handoff decision tree to Exp113 asset alignment and Exp114 state-aware transactional recovery after Exp112

adapter_contract.unit: one E02 task with exactly one eight-action window
adapter_contract.task_identity: instance_id/repository/base_commit from the allowlisted manifest projection

mapping_requirements: every position maps to exactly one candidate_id and call_index
every candidate_id maps back to exactly one position
all eight call indices are present in the source trajectory
all eight candidates have intervention_executable=true under the omission contract
no responsible position or probe result participates in mapping

record_reconstruction.source: the assistant-call sequence from the matched E02 SFT row
record_reconstruction.anonymous_role: role_0 for the single assistant action stream; no identity string
record_reconstruction.content: constant empty structural field; never read output text
record_reconstruction.thought: constant empty structural field; never read reasoning text
record_reconstruction.action: canonical JSON shape of the current public editor/tool call only
record_reconstruction.action_sanitization: recursively replace scalar values with type placeholders; preserve only anonymous type/list/depth/arity shape and public action-family category
record_reconstruction.graph: exact Exp112 temporal/same-role/same-shape/same-nonempty-action graph over the eight projected records

ranking_and_mapping.method: Exp112C fixed A+B2 stack deployment fit
ranking_and_mapping.output: one complete eight-position global ranking, then map ranked positions to candidate_id/call_index
ranking_and_mapping.mapping_audit: bijection, full coverage, no duplicate candidate, no missing candidate

folds.assignment: sort task_group values, random.Random(20260816).shuffle, fold i receives shuffled_groups[i::5]

oof_stack_features.fit: for each of five folds, fit fixed A/pairwise-B2 on the other four groups and predict the held fold exactly once
oof_stack_features.fit_stacker_on: all 731 development records' exactly-once OOF A/B2 features
oof_stack_features.gold_use: development Gold pair labels only inside the frozen train fit; never E02 Gold

final_fit.pairwise_and_b2: fit once on all 731 development records with Exp112 fixed helpers and hyperparameters
final_fit.stacker: fit once on all 731 OOF stack rows with the same fixed pairwise optimizer

fail_closed: loader counts not exactly 731 records/716 groups
fixed helper source binding cannot be proven
any deployment feature contains a forbidden field

fault_and_intervention_contract.fault_state: one evaluator-created controlled syntax suffix on the same E02 task/window, held hidden from all prediction inputs
fault_and_intervention_contract.shared_state: all five bridge arms and three handling baselines use the same task checkpoint, faulted final state, candidate pool and target probe
fault_and_intervention_contract.intervention: reconstruct the common pre-window checkpoint, replay to the common window end while omitting exactly the selected call's counterfactual delta, then run the fixed Python compile target probe
fault_and_intervention_contract.intervention_executable_definition: every assistant call is executable as a counterfactual omission; editor/state-changing calls omit their complete state delta, and read/search/other stateless calls use explicit no-op omission while the same probe still runs

intervention_kinds.state_delta_omission: state_changing=true; omit every edit belonging to the selected call while replaying all other applicable edits
intervention_kinds.stateless_noop_omission: state_changing=false; omit the selected stateless call explicitly, make no repository change for that omission, and still run the target probe

fault_and_intervention_contract.fault_unseal_order: fit and complete all predictions/rankings first; only then unseal evaluator responsible_position/fault_call for execution and scoring
fault_and_intervention_contract.fault_delta_rule: if selected position equals hidden responsible_position, omit the evaluator fault delta together with that call; otherwise keep the fault delta in the counterfactual branch
fault_and_intervention_contract.applicability: every one of eight candidate actions must have a deterministic state-delta omission or explicit stateless no-op path; otherwise the task fails the asset gate and is not repaired by a heuristic
fault_and_intervention_contract.target_probe: Python compile probe for the same target file used by E02
fault_and_intervention_contract.same_checkpoint_proof: checkpoint reconstructed from base_commit and the pre-window action prefix; no result checkpoint hash is used as a model feature

No.bridge_information: No attribution: no RQ1 responsibility attribution is transferred
No.selection: candidate position 0 under the frozen position tie rule; this is an attribution control, not a no-recovery arm

Shuffled.bridge_information: RQ1 Predicted score multiset with candidate assignment deterministically permuted
Shuffled.selection: shuffle Predicted scores using sha256(instance_id|Exp113|Shuffled|20260823), preserve the eight scores, then take top-1

Predicted.bridge_information: Exp112C deployment A+B2 full global ranking

Oracle.selection: hidden evaluator field only; never enters fit, prediction or live arm

bridge_arms.same_budget_assertion: all arms expose exactly one selected candidate and one target probe per task; Oracle is scored only as an upper bound

uniform-replay.selection: candidate position task_ordinal modulo 8 in stable manifest order

fixed-rollback.selection: last state-changing editor candidate in the common window; no score or Gold

handling_baselines.fairness: handling baselines receive the same candidate pool, checkpoint, fault state, probe and top-1 budget as bridge arms

data_and_split.asset_source: Exp113J accepted controlled asset-gate prerequisite (not re-audited by Exp114)

response_conditioned_replay.failed_transactions: no file mutation and no undo-history mutation
response_conditioned_replay.clone: git clone --no-checkout --no-hardlinks selected-local-source; checkout exact base commit

router_contract.target: continuous recovery utility from outer-train strategy-arm outcomes only
router_contract.strategy_sample_unit: outer-train task x registered strategy arm
router_contract.strategy_feature_category: frozen one-hot registered strategy category; Gold-free and not an identity field
router_contract.outer_train_source_projection: each training arm feature/order uses its inherited frozen source_selected_position; uniform does not seed-search
router_contract.held_route_projection: held route uses the current preregistered deterministic seed for uniform-replay after decisions are frozen
router_contract.zero_and_ties: retained as explicit arm labels; unavailable fixed-rollback is utility-zero abstention with no selected position
router_contract.conformal_residual_source: outer-train repository-group OOF; each sample predicted exactly once; final model refit after radius

decision_freeze.rq1_predicted_projection: accepted J Gold-free Predicted task->position only; remaining positions append in deterministic position order
decision_freeze.a_strategy_orders: Predicted prior, fixed-last reverse, seeded uniform-replay, fixed-rollback or explicit abstention
decision_freeze.raw_outcome_provider: outer-train strategy-arm labels only before fold-held digest; held responsible/fault only after digest unseal
decision_freeze.decision_digest: ranking + A route + B state + candidate order; held access before digest is fail closed

state_and_transaction.active: lower bound > 0, rollback feasible, executable; at most 1 candidate transaction
state_and_transaction.standby: interval contains 0 and upper > 0, executable; at most 3 independent candidates, first TNR pass commits
state_and_transaction.escalate: upper <= 0 or no executable candidate; zero automatic interventions
state_and_transaction.transaction: fresh exact-base clone for every candidate; conflict abort is transparent and never recovery success
tnr: non-target worktree hash equals No-recovery reference after excluding .git/pycache/target
no new transaction conflicts versus No-recovery reference
state_and_transaction.recovery_success: accepted candidate + target probe pass + TNR pass

gate.B_candidate: B relative >8% and pooled task-cluster CI lower >0
gate.B_formal_module_criterion: B relative >=10% and pooled task-cluster CI lower >0
gate.A_plus_B_candidate: relative gain >=15%, every seed positive, pooled task-cluster CI lower >0, strict > No/Random-attribution/RQ1 controls, Oracle>=A+B, harmful not worse, strict deletion/B-shuffle/route-shuffle checks
gate.pooled_bootstrap_unit: 34 task clusters; each cluster is the mean paired difference across three seeds
gate.method_and_chapter: not asserted by asset qualification or preflight

complete_config.title: RQ2 E02-native hardened state-cost observed final-checkpoint transactional recovery
complete_config.ownership: 实验/实验116_RQ2原生候选后验状态事务恢复/

correction.scope: field adaptation and observed transaction semantics only; no scientific redesign
correction.conflict_observed_definition: required boolean equal to conflict_count > 0; missing or inconsistent fields fail closed
correction.final_checkpoint_fault_anchor: effective call is max visible replayed call_index <= window_end_call
correction.original_fault_call: evaluator provenance only; never the injection argument
correction.responsible_candidate: receives the same effective call but underlying replay omits fault injection for sealed responsible position
correction.reference_eligibility: fault_injected=true and final target probe=false; reference pass is label zero/audit failure, not harness exception

scope.method_position: E02-native RQ2 B upgrade; not Exp112C and not an Exp112C B2 projection

inherited_facts.exp113j: accepted prerequisite only; verdict/path may be read once, no coverage/SHA/clone/security recheck
inherited_facts.exp114: read-only task projection and FreshTransactionalExecutor/TNR contract; no formal held metric is a decision input

native_projection.source: Exp114 read-only visible E02 task projection
native_projection.anonymous_digest: structural action/response/state categories only; no task/candidate/path/hash/Gold value
native_projection.candidate_id: retained only for executor lookup, never model input

label_provider.same_fault_candidate: execute only the responsible candidate for the positive label; other seven candidates are explicit recovery label=0 and unexecuted conflict_count=0
label_provider.positive_label: recovery success AND target probe pass AND TNR pass
label_provider.unexecuted_candidate: conflict_observed=false, conflict_count=0, attempt/probe cost=0; no conflict claim
label_provider.held_access: fail closed until complete posterior order, A route, state arm, budget and condition digest freeze

nested_oof.final_models: candidate/state/strategy models refit on outer-train only after inner OOF

protected_native_full_order.shuffle: posterior tail attribution changes in the frozen decision digest; state and budget retained
protected_native_full_order.random: J top1 plus seeded random tail without replacement

state_posterior.utility: policy arm utility = success - 0.01*observed_conflicts - 0.0001*(attempts*POLICY_ATTEMPT_COST), POLICY_ATTEMPT_COST=2; label observed_cost remains provenance only
state_posterior.training: inner-OOF protected order and exact outer-train same-fault labels
state_posterior.selection: continuous utility argmax with fixed lexicographic tie; no threshold search
state_posterior.formal_gate: all 24 repository-fold/seed fits must select at least two states and state-budget shuffle must be non-identity while preserving joint multiset

a_router.training: outer-train labels only, current fold refit
protected_union: A selected strategy top candidate if available
a_router.rollback_abstention: unavailable fixed-rollback is explicit abstention, never a position or success

condition_semantics.canonical_tail_reference: J top1 plus canonical tail, budget 3
condition_semantics.strategy_route_reference: A registered strategy route, fixed budget 3 without adaptive state
condition_semantics.exp116_b: native protected order plus learned state budget
condition_semantics.exp116_a_plus_b: J top1 -> A top -> native posterior union plus learned state
condition_semantics.candidate_posterior_shuffle: fold posterior tail permutation plus same state/budget
condition_semantics.state_shuffle: native order plus fold state/budget joint-multiset permutation
condition_semantics.a_route_shuffle: A route attribution permutation, native state retained
condition_semantics.protected_random_equal_budget: J top1 plus seeded random tail plus same state
condition_semantics.oracle_upper_bound: sealed resolver token in the digest; responsible position is injected only after held unseal, budget 1; comparator only

metrics_and_gate.statistics: three-seed task-cluster paired bootstrap; average seed differences within task before resampling 34 task clusters, 5000 draws
metrics_and_gate.b_formal_module: relative >=10% and pooled CI lower >0, strict candidate/state deletion+shuffle below B, Oracle >= B, core+B attribution audits; route attribution is not required
metrics_and_gate.a_plus_b_candidate: relative >=15%, all three seeds positive, pooled CI lower >0, strict controls, Oracle >= A+B, harmful not worse, core+B attribution+route audits
metrics_and_gate.strongest_baseline: global three-seed average from registered fair references only; no per-seed selection
core_audits: effective final-checkpoint fault is in replay window and shared
reference persistent fault injected and final target probe failed
metrics_and_gate.legacy_all_required_alias: core_audits AND b_attribution_audits AND ab_route_audits; not an independent B requirement

preflight.fixture: synthetic contract plus read-only native projection; no asset matrix recheck

execution.formal_pipeline: final-checkpoint adapter over read-only Exp114 source/train mapping, one shared reference plus eight outcomes, runtime anchoring audit and SHA receipt; not invoked
execution.failure_policy: stage-aware HARNESS_INVALID; paired writer removes partial publish

exp116e_namespace.claim_registration: complete staged JSON + fsync + no-replace link + directory fsync before qualification
exp116e_namespace.output_publish: same-filesystem staged file + os.link no-replace; ownership-safe cleanup; independent terminal COMMITTED only after both SHA receipts
exp116e_namespace.observed_executor: ObservedFinalCheckpointExecutor with E-owned mutation-point instrumentation and read-only Exp114 verifier

fault_occurrence_contract.source: E-owned mutation hook raw replay events; missing/duplicate/pseudo events fail closed

exp116e_namespace.cache_schema: Exp116E-cache/2.0; one validator for executor and formal cache audit

fair_baseline.selection_rule: strongest same-information fair non-oracle baseline among frozen no-recovery/retry/fixed/uniform/A standalone; upgrade automatically if stronger

runtime_audits.freeze_unseal: derive current-fold source access log and reject any held read before exactly one decision freeze/unseal
runtime_audits.capacity: recompute assignment rows, budget/state multisets, actual total and upper bound from frozen fold data
runtime_audits.cache: parent E schema, final-checkpoint/fault-anchor, shared-reference and TNR provenance validators are mandatory
runtime_audits.tnr_scope: chosen execution target/TNR/conflict/cost/provenance fields are required; not every candidate must pass TNR
runtime_audits.controls: candidate full-posterior, state/action, A-route and coupling controls are recomputed; malformed structure/multiset fails closed, while semantic identity is recorded as nonidentity=false, degenerate=true and makes the scientific gate STOP without HARNESS_INVALID
runtime_audits.control_degeneracy: degenerate controls preserve the full budget/semantic multiset and recompute target orders under registered semantics; runtime_audit_complete remains true, but the corresponding scientific control audit and Gate are false
runtime_audits.paired_commit: stage output and audit, verify cross-SHA, publish exclusively, then write COMMITTED terminal; cleanup on any failure

complete_config.purpose: RQ2 broad policy-envelope feasibility experiment with train-only nested-OOF selection and one outer-held evaluation

scope.goal: RQ2 strict chapter GO feasibility, stopping immediately when the conjunctive gate is met

B.pipeline: native candidate posterior/full ranking -> task x transaction-arm expected recovery/TNR utility plus uncertainty -> deterministic multiple-choice resource allocation -> same-checkpoint transactional no-regression
B.standalone_action: Escalate0 plus frozen native-B ranking under the allocated budget

policy_envelope.family_selection: pre_registered inner repository-group OOF safe tie-break; never outer-held
policy_envelope.action_value_estimator: cross-fitted repository-group OOF utility/TNR/cost estimator; final outer-train fit only; diagonal ridge=100.0 on standardized visible semantic features and fixed correction shrinkage=0.10, with no task waveform/hash phase
policy_envelope.held_predictions: visible candidate/native features only; held labels cannot enter model fit, family selection, or tie-break
policy_envelope.family_selection_audit: inner-OOF policy value with fixed safe tie-break; never per-task held/train oracle maximum

capacity.optimization: deterministic multiple-choice knapsack under total attempts upper bound; state counts emerge from train-only action-value optimization

fair_baseline.selection_rule: strongest same-information fair non-oracle baseline among frozen no-recovery/retry/fixed/uniform/A standalone; upgrade automatically if stronger

runtime_audits.freeze_unseal: derive current-fold source access log and reject any held read before exactly one decision freeze/unseal
runtime_audits.capacity: recompute assignment rows, budget/state multisets, actual total and upper bound from frozen fold data
runtime_audits.cache: parent E schema, final-checkpoint/fault-anchor, shared-reference and TNR provenance validators are mandatory
runtime_audits.tnr_scope: chosen execution target/TNR/conflict/cost/provenance fields are required; not every candidate must pass TNR
runtime_audits.controls: candidate full-posterior, state/action, A-route and coupling controls are recomputed; malformed structure/multiset fails closed, while semantic identity is recorded as nonidentity=false, degenerate=true and makes the scientific gate STOP without HARNESS_INVALID
runtime_audits.control_degeneracy: degenerate controls preserve the full budget/semantic multiset and recompute target orders under registered semantics; runtime_audit_complete remains true, but the corresponding scientific control audit and Gate are false
runtime_audits.paired_commit: stage output and audit, verify cross-SHA, publish exclusively, then write COMMITTED terminal; cleanup on any failure

gates.b_candidate: B > 8% relative and task-group paired bootstrap lower > 0
gates.b_formal_module: B >= 10% relative and CI lower > 0 and candidate/state/action deletion+shuffle strictly below B and all scientific audits pass
gates.a_plus_b_chapter: A+B >= 15% relative, all three seeds positive, CI lower > 0, strict superiority to No/Random/Shuffled/A-deletion/A-route-shuffle/coupling deletion+shuffle/B, Oracle >= full, harmful not worse
gates.strict_chapter_go: B formal module AND A+B chapter gate
gates.positive_not_go: retain every real non-error positive result but do not call GO

crc_safety_gate.score_source: repository-group cross-fitted harm/nonconformity scores from current outer-train only
crc_safety_gate.repository_block_weights: equal data-independent weights for each of the seven train repository blocks
crc_safety_gate.policy_safe_anchor: fixed registered uniform_equal_comparable_budget under the inherited capacity contract
crc_safety_gate.anchor_group_harm_cap: derive q_anchor from the outer-train safe anchor's equal-block group harm estimate and conservative UCB before any success optimization
crc_safety_gate.q_anchor_algorithm: for G nonempty train repository blocks with block harm rates r_g, m=mean_g(r_g), v=sum_g((r_g-m)^2)/max(1,G-1), q_anchor=clip_01(m+1.96*sqrt(v/G)); score scale is the unit-interval harm rate
crc_safety_gate.score_algorithm: for each action, outer-train repository-group cross-fitted harm score is the clipped equal-block action harm rate; uncertainty is clip_01(min(0.5, sqrt(sample_variance/max(1,n)) + 1/sqrt(n))) on the same unit scale
crc_safety_gate.eligible_rule: before held unseal, action is eligible iff it is Escalate0 OR predicted_harm_score + lambda * uncertainty <= q_anchor; prefix_safe, TNR, provenance, target_probe, and any held outcome are never read for eligibility
crc_safety_gate.held_decision_eligibility: freeze eligibility before unseal from predicted_harm_score + lambda * uncertainty <= q_anchor, with Escalate0 as the legal abstention; the held action path cannot inspect prefix_safe, TNR/provenance, target_probe, or any held outcome
crc_safety_gate.post_execution_validation: after the frozen action executes, validate actual prefix_safe (= no_harm AND complete TNR/provenance) and record TNR/provenance and success metrics; this posterior validation cannot alter the frozen action
crc_safety_gate.anchor_boundary: all candidate safe sets use the same anchor-derived q_anchor and cannot be wider than the anchor-cap boundary
crc_safety_gate.lambda_monotonicity: lambda_1 <= lambda_2 implies SafeSet(lambda_2) is a subset of SafeSet(lambda_1)
crc_safety_gate.loss_monotonicity: for every task, increasing lambda can only remove actions and can only weakly decrease the harmful-action inclusion loss
crc_safety_gate.lambda_selection: discard candidates violating the anchor group-harm UCB/cap; among remaining nested safe sets choose maximum inherited utility subject to the cap, then freeze lambda before outer-held unseal

alpha.role: derived calibration report field from q_anchor, never a success-seeking threshold knob
alpha.finite_candidates_if_implemented: every candidate must use the same or stricter anchor q_anchor and remain a subset of the anchor-cap safe set

crc_safety_gate.group_limitation: only seven train repositories are available; report effective block weight/sample and empirical/bound harm; this is group-aware conservative adaptation, not a distribution-free or exact IID guarantee
