sources.citation: Angelopoulos et al., Conformal Risk Control
not_absorbed: an IID or distribution-free guarantee beyond the registered group assumptions

sources.citation: Farinhas et al., Non-Exchangeable Conformal Risk Control
sources.adaptation: equal data-independent repository-block weights with only seven train repositories; this is group-aware conservative adaptation, not a distribution-free guarantee

sources.citation: Straitouri et al., Controlling Counterfactual Harm in Decision Support Systems Based on Prediction Sets
absorbed: abstention when no safe non-Escalate action exists

literature_basis.common_boundary: only the existing visible semantic, TNR, conflict, cost, provenance, native posterior, and parent utility features are allowed; literature supplies the risk-gate idea only

rq2_lineage.module_A: Exp108 diagnostic registered strategy route; parameters are frozen and it remains the A route
rq2_lineage.module_B: existing state-aware transactional recovery module using native posterior/full ranking, absolute utility heads, uncertainty, capacity DP, same-checkpoint TNR
rq2_lineage.exp119: risk-calibration upgrade of B before its existing action-value/DP decision; not an independent module and not a new action/capacity design
rq2_lineage.reporting_rule: report RQ2 as A plus B; do not count Exp119 as a third module

data_surface.fold_grouping: repository-group outer split; task groups remain intact for paired bootstrap
data_surface.held_usage: each outer fold freezes all method/control decisions once, then unseals held cache exactly once

inherited_parent_contract.source: Exp118C frozen parent semantics are re-fit from current outer-train inputs; no Exp118C formal file is read
inherited_parent_contract.native_ranking: protected native posterior/full ranking with the parent tie and provenance contract
inherited_parent_contract.utility_uncertainty: parent uncertainty estimates are re-fit on current outer-train groups and frozen before held unseal
inherited_parent_contract.action_value_policy: reuse parent absolute success/TNR/cost utility-head semantics; do not introduce a new absolute action-value model or held feedback
inherited_parent_contract.capacity_policy: reuse parent deterministic multiple-choice capacity objective and DP; no new joint allocator or state quota
inherited_parent_contract.transaction: reuse parent same-checkpoint transactional execution and true TNR provenance
inherited_parent_contract.formal_file_access: Exp118C protocol/design may be consulted as frozen contract context, but its outer formal output/audit/claim/terminal/metrics are forbidden inputs

B.module_role: existing RQ2 B transactional-recovery module with one CRC risk gate inserted before the inherited action-value/DP decision
B.pipeline: native posterior/full ranking + inherited absolute success/TNR/cost utility heads + uncertainty -> repository-group CRC counterfactual-harm safe action set -> inherited multiple-choice capacity objective/DP -> same-checkpoint transactional TNR execution

protected_native_B_budget1_2_3.order: protected native posterior/full ranking truncated to budget

A_plus_B.pipeline: parent A/B stable-dedup route choices -> the same CRC safe-action gate -> inherited absolute utility/DP/capacity -> same-checkpoint transactional TNR
A_plus_B.stable_dedup: parent stable first-occurrence candidate-position dedup; no new route family

outer_train_policy_labels.source: outer-train full-information cache only, after complete same-fault transaction evaluation of all eight candidates

counterfactual_replay.source: already executed complete same-fault candidate cache for the current outer-train task; responsible-only provider rows are forbidden
counterfactual_replay.stop: replay the cached prefix and stop at the first verified success or at the frozen budget
counterfactual_replay.missing_or_inconsistent_record: fail closed; never synthesize a label or default unexecuted TNR/provenance

outer_train_policy_labels.safety_label: prefix_safe = no_harm AND complete TNR/provenance evidence
outer_train_policy_labels.success_utility_label: success = recovery_success AND target_probe_pass AND TNR pass; target_probe belongs only to the inherited utility/success head
outer_train_policy_labels.safe_but_unsuccessful_contract: a prefix with no_harm and complete TNR/provenance remains a safety-positive sample even when recovery_success or target_probe_pass is false
outer_train_policy_labels.future_test_contract: future tests/preflight must assert safe-but-unsuccessful samples are retained as safety-positive and target_probe is not in the safety label

forbidden_features: Exp118C outer formal metrics or records

crc_safety_gate.score_source: repository-group cross-fitted harm/nonconformity scores from current outer-train only
crc_safety_gate.repository_block_weights: equal data-independent weights for each of the seven train repository blocks
crc_safety_gate.policy_safe_anchor: fixed registered uniform_equal_comparable_budget under the inherited capacity contract
crc_safety_gate.anchor_group_harm_cap: derive q_anchor from the outer-train safe anchor's equal-block group harm estimate and conservative UCB before any success optimization
crc_safety_gate.q_anchor_algorithm: for G nonempty train repository blocks with block harm rates r_g, m=mean_g(r_g), v=sum_g((r_g-m)^2)/max(1,G-1), q_anchor=clip_01(m+1.96*sqrt(v/G)); score scale is the unit-interval harm rate
crc_safety_gate.score_algorithm: for each action, outer-train repository-group cross-fitted harm score is the clipped equal-block action harm rate; uncertainty is clip_01(min(0.5, sqrt(sample_variance/max(1,n)) + 1/sqrt(n))) on the same unit scale
crc_safety_gate.eligible_rule: before held unseal, action is eligible iff it is Escalate0 OR predicted_harm_score + lambda * uncertainty <= q_anchor; prefix_safe, TNR, provenance, target_probe, and any held outcome are never read for eligibility
crc_safety_gate.held_decision_eligibility: freeze eligibility before unseal from predicted_harm_score + lambda * uncertainty <= q_anchor, with Escalate0 as the legal abstention; the held action path cannot inspect prefix_safe, TNR/provenance, target_probe, or any held outcome
crc_safety_gate.post_execution_validation: after the frozen action executes, validate actual prefix_safe (= no_harm AND complete TNR/provenance) and record TNR/provenance and success metrics; this posterior validation cannot alter the frozen action
crc_safety_gate.anchor_boundary: all candidate safe sets use the same anchor-derived q_anchor and cannot be wider than the anchor-cap boundary
crc_safety_gate.lambda_monotonicity: lambda_1 <= lambda_2 implies SafeSet(lambda_2) is a subset of SafeSet(lambda_1)
crc_safety_gate.loss_monotonicity: for every task, increasing lambda can only remove actions and can only weakly decrease the harmful-action inclusion loss
crc_safety_gate.lambda_selection: discard candidates violating the anchor group-harm UCB/cap; among remaining nested safe sets choose maximum inherited utility subject to the cap, then freeze lambda before outer-held unseal

alpha.role: derived calibration report field from q_anchor, never a success-seeking threshold knob
alpha.finite_candidates_if_implemented: every candidate must use the same or stricter anchor q_anchor and remain a subset of the anchor-cap safe set

crc_safety_gate.group_limitation: only seven train repositories are available; report effective block weight/sample and empirical/bound harm; this is group-aware conservative adaptation, not a distribution-free or exact IID guarantee

capacity_and_fairness.dp_objective: parent absolute success/TNR/cost utility objective restricted to CRC-safe actions

fair_baseline_equal_budget_multiset.odd_n: one task budget1 selected by the deterministic anonymous total order and every other task budget2
fair_baseline_equal_budget_multiset.anonymous_total_order: lexicographic normalized finite visible-feature digest first, then canonical candidate position
fair_baseline_equal_budget_multiset.digest_collision: canonical candidate position is the only tie-break
fair_baseline_equal_budget_multiset.same_digest_and_position: fail closed; never use task/repository identity or insertion order

capacity_and_fairness.no_recovery: zero-attempt diagnostic, reported separately and excluded from strongest_fair_baseline

shared_rules.deterministic_condition_seed: formal seed + outer fold + condition name; never task id/hash

control_semantics.candidate_posterior_deletion: delete posterior evidence, retain the parent registered native route semantics, then rerun inherited utility/DP and TNR
control_semantics.candidate_posterior_shuffle: seeded-permute posterior evidence while preserving its multiset, recompute inherited orders/utility/DP and TNR
control_semantics.state_action_deletion: delete inherited state/action distinction and recompute the parent comparable-budget decision
control_semantics.state_action_shuffle: seeded-permute inherited state/action semantics while preserving joint budget/state multiset and recompute decision
control_semantics.a_deletion: remove A route from AB and rerun the parent B envelope with the same CRC gate and capacity
control_semantics.a_route_shuffle: seeded-permute A route semantics while preserving route/budget multiset and recompute stable-dedup order
control_semantics.coupling_deletion: remove A/B coupling arms while retaining parent standalone A/B arms and rerun inherited DP
control_semantics.coupling_shuffle: seeded-permute coupling labels while preserving their multiset and total capacity, then recompute order
control_semantics.protected_random_equal_actual_budget: protected random route/order under the same actual equal-comparable budget multiset and parent capacity
control_semantics.CRC_deletion: remove repository-group CRC calibration and use the pre-registered uncalibrated fixed harm-score threshold 0.5; no held tuning
control_semantics.CRC_score_shuffle: seeded-permute cross-fitted harm/nonconformity scores while preserving score multiset, recompute the safe set and inherited utility/DP

gate_control_mapping.no_cross_context_comparison: B is never compared against A deletion, A route shuffle, coupling deletion, or coupling shuffle; AB is compared against those controls only in the AB context; each CRC top-level condition emits distinct B and AB paired variants

structural_control_eligibility.degenerate_definition: a fold's control support/multiset is single-valued so the registered deletion or permutation cannot change its semantic target
structural_control_eligibility.per_seed_requirement: each formal seed has at least one eligible changed support for every required parent/CRC control family
structural_control_eligibility.eligible_fold_requirement: every eligible fold proves nonidentity, multiset preservation, recomputed order/action, and capacity preservation
structural_control_eligibility.all_na_rule: all-N/A family or missing per-seed changed support fails attribution rather than passing
structural_control_eligibility.na_encoding: N/A is explicit, never numeric zero or pass

comparison_support.eligible_support: exact intersection of task groups/folds where method and that control are both eligible and control proves nonidentity
comparison_support.paired_rsr_and_bootstrap: recompute method/control RSR and paired bootstrap on the identical eligible support
comparison_support.full_support: also report all-task/all-fold metrics with explicit N/A
comparison_support.support_digest: publish eligible task-group support identity/count per comparison

policy_risk_safe_anchor.group_harm_cap_source: outer-train equal repository-block harm estimate and conservative UCB

strongest_fair_baseline.selection_phase: outer-held formal reporting only after all pool members and methods execute and unseal
strongest_fair_baseline.selection_rule: pooled maximum outer-held RSR over the full pool; separate per-seed maximum for per-seed reporting

bootstrap_reference.pooled_ci: one pooled task-group paired bootstrap relative to one pooled strongest_fair_baseline condition
bootstrap_reference.per_seed_strongest_role: per-seed strongest baseline only for per-seed description and A+B all-seed-positive gate

metrics.positive_signal_policy: retain every non-error positive result even when a strict gate is false

runtime_audits.train_inner_outer_isolation: prove repository-group disjointness and outer-held-once use
runtime_audits.exp118c_isolation: prove no runner/model/selection helper reads any Exp118C outer formal file/metric
runtime_audits.utility_safety_separation: verify prefix_safe excludes target_probe, safe-but-unsuccessful samples remain safety-positive, and target_probe is only in success utility
runtime_audits.counterfactual_replay: verify frozen order/budget/first-success deterministic replay from executed outer-train same-fault cache
runtime_audits.crc: verify equal block weights, anchor-derived harm cap/UCB, single-lambda nested safe sets, loss non-increasing in lambda, effective block/sample, empirical/bound harm, and held threshold freeze
runtime_audits.parent_attribution_controls: verify inherited deletion/shuffle controls, nonidentity/multiset/capacity, and same checkpoint/TNR provenance
runtime_audits.fair_baseline: evaluate full fair-baseline pool on held data, select pooled/per-seed strongest only for report/gate
runtime_audits.comparison_support: pair method/control on the same eligible task-group support and also report full support
runtime_audits.control_support_status: each fold records eligible, structurally_ineligible, or invalid; N/A is explicit, every seed must retain at least one eligible changed support, and full-support metrics never encode N/A as zero
runtime_audits.capacity: recompute parent total upper bound, fair baseline multiset, anonymous total order, and early-stop semantics
runtime_audits.oracle: read held outcomes only after unseal and record zero ceilings legally
runtime_audits.paired_writer: stage output/audit, fsync, cross-check SHA/inode/token, publish no-replace, then write COMMITTED terminal

gates.b_candidate: B relative > 8% to the pooled strongest fair baseline and pooled task-group CI lower > 0
gates.b_strict_chapter_module: B relative >= 10% to the pooled strongest fair baseline, pooled task-group paired CI lower > 0 against that same single pooled baseline condition, B strictly exceeds every eligible parent attribution/random/CRC control on identical eligible support, harmful rate/count not higher than formal strongest fair baseline, CRC and parent audits pass
gates.ab_strict_chapter_candidate: A+B relative >= 15% to the pooled strongest fair baseline, pooled CI lower > 0 against that same single pooled baseline condition, all three seeds positive only against their corresponding per-seed strongest baselines, strictly exceeds B and every eligible parent AB control on identical support, harm not higher than formal strongest fair baseline and B, Oracle >= A+B, all audits pass
gates.strict_rq2_chapter_go: B strict chapter module AND A+B strict chapter candidate
gates.positive_not_go: retain real positive results but do not label GO when any conjunctive gate is false
gates.stop_rule: stop RQ2 feasibility immediately at strict GO; otherwise retain signal and decide the next justified upgrade

import boto3
from moto import mock_dynamodb
import os

os.environ["AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"] = "testing"
os.environ["AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"] = "testing"
os.environ["AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN"] = "testing"
os.environ["AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"] = "testing"

def create_table(client, table_name):
    return client.create_table(
        AttributeDefinitions=[
            {"AttributeName": "AMI_Id", "AttributeType": "S"},
        ],
        TableName=table_name,
        KeySchema=[
            {"AttributeName": "AMI_Id", "KeyType": "HASH"},
        ],
        BillingMode="PAY_PER_REQUEST",
        StreamSpecification={
            "StreamEnabled": True,
            "StreamViewType": "NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES",
        },
        SSESpecification={
            "Enabled": False,
        },
        TableClass="STANDARD",
    )

with mock_dynamodb():
    # Create table in us-east-1
    dynamo_east1 = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name="us-east-1")
    table1 = create_table(dynamo_east1, "table_east1")
    arn1 = dynamo_east1.describe_table(TableName="table_east1")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 1 ARN: {arn1}")
    assert "us-east-1" in arn1, "Table 1 was not created in us-east-1!"

    # Create table in us-east-2
    dynamo_east2 = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name="us-east-2")
    table2 = create_table(dynamo_east2, "table_east2")
    arn2 = dynamo_east2.describe_table(TableName="table_east2")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 2 ARN: {arn2}")
    assert "us-east-2" in arn2, "Table 2 was not created in us-east-2!"

    # Create table in us-west-1
    dynamo_west1 = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name="us-west-1")
    table3 = create_table(dynamo_west1, "table_west1")
    arn3 = dynamo_west1.describe_table(TableName="table_west1")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 3 ARN: {arn3}")
    assert "us-west-1" in arn3, "Table 3 was not created in us-west-1!"

print("All tests passed!")

import boto3
import uuid

def test_sns_topic_wrong_region():
    region = "us-east-1"
    region_wrong = "us-west-2"

    sns_client = boto3.client("sns", region_name=region)
    topic_name = "test-sns-" + str(uuid.uuid4())
    response = sns_client.create_topic(
        Name=topic_name,
        Attributes={
            "DisplayName": "hello topic",
        },
    )

    # here the topic was created in "region", and we are fetching it in "region_wrong"
    topic_arn = response["TopicArn"]
    sns_resource = boto3.resource("sns", region_name=region_wrong)
    topic = sns_resource.Topic(topic_arn)
    topic.load()  # This should raise a ClientError

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_sns_topic_wrong_region()

easd.knowledge: static paper Overstep/Loop paradigms and explicit observed permissions; unknown permissions not invented

easd.scope_ties: Overstep before Loop; chronological within each; pair deduplication
easd.empty_scope: localization still uses complete logs with empty hint

recovery_budget.stop: first visible restore pass; then one preservation acceptance
recovery_budget.success: restore tests AND preservation tests AND legal edit state
recovery_budget.single_step_fallback: predicted step first, then reverse execution time; fallback is not native diagnosis ranking

import numpy as np
from monai.data import Dataset
from monai.transforms import RandSpatialCropSamplesd, Compose, ToTensord, DeleteItemsd
from monai.utils import first

sz = (1, 10, 11, 12)
samples_per_img = 3

    roi_size=(3, 3, 3),
    num_samples=samples_per_img,
    random_center=True,
    random_size=False,
)

    [ToTensord(keys="img"), sampler],
    [sampler],
    [ToTensord(keys="img"), DeleteItemsd(keys="img_transforms"), sampler]
]

    ds = Dataset(data=list_of_data, transform=Compose(trafo_chain))
    sample = first(ds)
    print([d["class"] for d in sample[0]["img_transforms"]])

from moto import mock_ec2
import boto3

# Initialize the mock EC2 service
def setup_ec2():
    mock = mock_ec2()
    mock.start()
    return mock

def create_spot_fleet(ec2_client):
    # Create a spot fleet request
    response = ec2_client.request_spot_fleet(
        SpotFleetRequestConfig={
            'IamFleetRole': 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/fleet',
            'LaunchSpecifications': [
                {
                    'ImageId': 'ami-12345678',
                    'InstanceType': 't2.micro',
                    'SpotPrice': '0.02',
                    'SubnetId': 'subnet-12345678',
                },
            ],
            'TargetCapacity': 1,
            'Type': 'request',
        }
    )
    return response['SpotFleetRequestId']

def cancel_spot_fleet(ec2_client, spot_fleet_request_id, terminate_instances):
    # Cancel the spot fleet request
    ec2_client.cancel_spot_fleet_requests(

import dask.array as da
import numpy as np

def test_mask_preserving_functions():
    array = da.ma.masked_array([2, 3, 4], mask=[0, 0, 1])
    
    # Test ones_like
    result_ones = da.ones_like(array).compute()
    expected_ones = np.ones_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_ones, expected_ones), f"ones_like failed: {result_ones} != {expected_ones}"

    # Test zeros_like
    result_zeros = da.zeros_like(array).compute()
    expected_zeros = np.zeros_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_zeros, expected_zeros), f"zeros_like failed: {result_zeros} != {expected_zeros}"

    # Test empty_like
    result_empty = da.empty_like(array).compute()
    expected_empty = np.empty_like(array.compute())
    # We cannot directly compare uninitialized data from empty_like, so we check the mask
    assert np.array_equal(np.ma.getmask(result_empty), np.ma.getmask(expected_empty)), "empty_like mask failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_mask_preserving_functions()
    print("All tests passed!")

import dask.array as da
import numpy as np

def test_mask_preserving_functions():
    array = da.ma.masked_array([2, 3, 4], mask=[0, 0, 1])
    
    # Test ones_like
    result_ones = da.ones_like(array).compute()
    expected_ones = np.ones_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_ones, expected_ones), f"ones_like failed: {result_ones} != {expected_ones}"

    # Test zeros_like
    result_zeros = da.zeros_like(array).compute()
    expected_zeros = np.zeros_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_zeros, expected_zeros), f"zeros_like failed: {result_zeros} != {expected_zeros}"

    # Test empty_like
    result_empty = da.empty_like(array).compute()
    expected_empty = np.empty_like(array.compute())
    # We cannot directly compare uninitialized data from empty_like, so we check the mask
    assert np.array_equal(np.ma.getmask(result_empty), np.ma.getmask(expected_empty)), "empty_like mask failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_mask_preserving_functions()
    print("All tests passed!")

from dask.base import tokenize

# Test case 1: Enum with auto() values
class Status(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()

# Test case 2: IntEnum
class Priority(IntEnum):
    LOW = 0
    MEDIUM = 1
    HIGH = 2

# Test case 3: Flag enum
class Permissions(Flag):
    READ = 1
    WRITE = 2
    EXECUTE = 4

def test_case(name, value1, value2):
    token1 = tokenize(value1)
    token2 = tokenize(value2)
    print(f"\n{name}:")
    print(f"Token1: {token1}")
    print(f"Token2: {token2}")
    print(f"Tokens equal? {token1 == token2}")
    assert token1 == token2, f"Tokens should be equal for {name}"

# Test same enum values
test_case("Basic Enum with auto()", Status.PENDING, Status.PENDING)
test_case("IntEnum", Priority.MEDIUM, Priority.MEDIUM)
test_case("Flag Enum", Permissions.READ, Permissions.READ)

# Test combined flags
combined = Permissions.READ | Permissions.WRITE
test_case("Combined Flags", combined, Permissions.READ | Permissions.WRITE)

print("\nAll edge cases passed!")

import sys
from mypy import api

def run_mypy_check(python_version):
    # Set up a temporary directory structure
    os.makedirs('test_dir/@python2', exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs('test_dir', exist_ok=True)

    # Create a dummy Python file in the @python2 directory

        f.write('def foo():\n    return "Python 2 version"\n')

    # Create a dummy Python file in the main directory
    with open('test_dir/dummy.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write('def foo():\n    return "Python 3 version"\n')

    # Set the Python version in options

    # Run mypy

    print(f"Running mypy with Python {python_version}:")
    print(result[0])  # stdout
    print(result[1])  # stderr

    # Clean up
    os.remove('test_dir/@python2/dummy.py')
    os.remove('test_dir/dummy.py')
    os.rmdir('test_dir/@python2')
    os.rmdir('test_dir')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_mypy_check('2.7')  # Test with Python 2
    run_mypy_check('3.8')  # Test with Python 3

    array = da.ma.masked_array([2, 3, 4], mask=[0, 0, 1])
    
    # Test ones_like

    print("All tests passed!")

import dask.array as da
import numpy as np

def test_mask_preserving_functions():
    array = da.ma.masked_array([2, 3, 4], mask=[0, 0, 1])
    
    # Test ones_like
    result_ones = da.ones_like(array).compute()
    expected_ones = np.ones_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_ones, expected_ones), f"ones_like failed: {result_ones} != {expected_ones}"

    # Test zeros_like
    result_zeros = da.zeros_like(array).compute()
    expected_zeros = np.zeros_like(array.compute())
    assert np.array_equal(result_zeros, expected_zeros), f"zeros_like failed: {result_zeros} != {expected_zeros}"

    # Test empty_like
    result_empty = da.empty_like(array).compute()
    expected_empty = np.empty_like(array.compute())
    # We cannot directly compare uninitialized data from empty_like, so we check the mask
    assert np.array_equal(np.ma.getmask(result_empty), np.ma.getmask(expected_empty)), "empty_like mask failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_mask_preserving_functions()
    print("All tests passed!")

import boto3
from moto import mock_dynamodb
import os

os.environ["AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"] = "testing"
os.environ["AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN"] = "testing"
os.environ["AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"] = "testing"

def create_table(client, table_name):
    return client.create_table(
        AttributeDefinitions=[
            {"AttributeName": "AMI_Id", "AttributeType": "S"},
        ],
        TableName=table_name,
        KeySchema=[
            {"AttributeName": "AMI_Id", "KeyType": "HASH"},
        ],
        BillingMode="PAY_PER_REQUEST",
        StreamSpecification={
            "StreamEnabled": True,
            "StreamViewType": "NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES",
        },
        SSESpecification={
            "Enabled": False,
        },
        TableClass="STANDARD",
    )

with mock_dynamodb():
    # Create table in us-east-1
    dynamo_east1 = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name="us-east-1")
    table1 = create_table(dynamo_east1, "table_east1")
    arn1 = dynamo_east1.describe_table(TableName="table_east1")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 1 ARN: {arn1}")

    # Create table in us-east-2
    dynamo_east2 = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name="us-east-2")
    table2 = create_table(dynamo_east2, "table_east2")
    arn2 = dynamo_east2.describe_table(TableName="table_east2")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 2 ARN: {arn2}")
    assert "us-east-2" in arn2, "Table 2 was not created in us-east-2!"

    # Create table in us-west-1

    table3 = create_table(dynamo_west1, "table_west1")
    arn3 = dynamo_west1.describe_table(TableName="table_west1")["Table"]["TableArn"]
    print(f"Table 3 ARN: {arn3}")
    assert "us-west-1" in arn3, "Table 3 was not created in us-west-1!"

print("All tests passed!")

reasoning: 支持面必须承认：626条记录中目标会改变，同角色负例通常只是全部负例的一部分；候选绝非概率分解恒等式，也不能称为近乎完全相同的目标。原pair负例均值会稀释同角色的逐项系数。
决定降级的反证：固定29个同角色错误的final原CE已经把99.6656%的负例质量放在同角色，原CE+pair也达到98.8272%，重权后仅变为99.6901%；base同类95.9670%变为96.7731%。因此，最直接的最终错误并未表现出大量监督被其他角色分走。完整96个同角色错误中的final同样从97.3478%变为98.4922%，不是仅固定120呈现的现象。
7.5749%的负例score梯度L1变化并非零，也没有普遍阈值允许断言它必定无效。但这主要证明对已经受重点惩罚的负例再次调节力度，不能证明调节方向可补足步间判别证据。原pair质量约0.0578增至0.1180，说明变化不能仅以比例提高不到1个百分点概括；它仍未解决为何已有大幅CE惩罚未泛化为正确排序的问题。

A/B是保留可能性的最强正证据：同一29条上的同角色分配分别从84.8857%到89.1162%、61.5089%到66.6024%，负例score梯度约11.1%变化。A/B各自占一个辅助slot，变化可经共享参数传递，不能忽略。但这些记录按final错误筛选，不是A/B各自的错误集合；没有参数Jacobian、四slot合成或改目标后的排序证据。辅助分量的更大分配变化不能自动推翻final/base已集中监督的反证。
agentic-injected是最突出的错误层，但final分配只从87.8557%到88.5995%，L1变化8.0183%；B从54.8731%到59.6333%说明辅助效应仍可能存在，尚不足以把该层缺口归因于负例分配。不能由此承诺能纠正其16个同角色错步。
本候选同时移除k>0记录中跨角色负例的pair监督。固定13个跨角色错误中11个会受到这种变化；global CE仍在，因此不能断言必定损害，但也不能只计同角色可能收益而把其他错误当成免费保持。
全731的final同角色份额约54%不能覆盖上述反证：其中包括105条无同角色竞争以及许多已正确、梯度质量很小的记录，而摘要平均的是各记录比例。它不等于模型把近一半训练梯度浪费在跨角色上。错误子集上的接近100%也部分受同角色高分错排这一筛选定义影响；其意义是没有观察到所假设的明显监督缺口，并不是证明整个训练过程已经充分。
这是一轮固定主seed已拟合OOF读出的分析，不能证明训练期同角色梯度始终充足，也不能证明重权必败。优先级却必须由正面的瓶颈证据支持；当前最强支持只是数学非等价与辅助分量发生有限变化，尚不足以建议消耗下一轮完整训练预算。

architecture.pair: Shared tanh Linear288->96 of q96,xi96,xj96, ordered i!=j; c_i mean_j p_ij enters every common head.

architecture.A_control: Same e, only+e to j; no outgoing subtraction.
architecture.B: Omit only candidate memory write; D recomputes future gates/full proposals, U uses cached factual gates/full proposals; mean_future dot(shared p,D-U)/sqrt96. Last candidate=0.
architecture.B_control: Only substitute F-U for D-U; same suffix/pair/readout.
architecture.replay_implementation: At time t, independent factual and all existing candidate-D rows share a batched Slot update; U reuses factual a,v. No row mixing, no detach, no stochastic masks. CPU values and gradients must match reference.
